zh: 适合建立 AI for Science 的全景认识；不同学科的成果不能用一个统一分数比较。
en: Use it to map AI for Science; results across disciplines do not share one universal score.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 这张总览把数据、模型和科学工作连接起来。阅读时区分用于理解数据的模型、生成候选的方法和验证候选的实验。
figures.en: The overview connects scientific data, models and research activities. Distinguish data understanding, candidate generation and the experiments validating candidates.

zh.context: 这篇 Nature 综述提供的是 AI 进入科研的基础地图。它覆盖数据、模型和发现流程，帮助读者理解为什么科学 AI 不只是对已有数据做预测，还可能改变假设生成、实验选择和设计搜索。
steps: 从科学数据的特点出发，讨论怎样利用大量未标注数据学习表示，减少对人工标签的依赖。
把领域结构带入模型，例如利用几何关系约束学习，或用生成模型提出新的分子、材料及其他候选设计。
把模型放回实际研究流程：候选需要通过计算、观测或实验检验，所得数据再支持后续建模与新的研究方向。
evidence: 文章综述了过去十年的方法与应用进展，包含自监督学习、几何深度学习和生成式方法。其证据来自多个领域已有研究的综合，没有一个统一 agent、统一数据集或可直接横向比较的总成绩。
它的重要作用是把技术能力和科研步骤对应起来：较好的表示可支持预测，生成模型扩大候选空间，实验选择影响有限资源投向哪里。每一类作用都应回到相应案例的评价标准判断。
zh.visual: Fig. 1 是全景图，适合先定位 AI 作用于哪一段研究过程，再追问输入、输出与验证方式。图中的连接说明研究活动可以互相影响，不表示所有环节都已经由同一套系统自主完成。
zh.caveat: 这篇文章发表于 2023 年，适合作为概念基础，不能直接代表后续 agent 系统的最新能力。可借鉴的是先根据科学问题选择学习方法，再明确最终验证依靠什么；预测准确、候选新颖和科学发现是不同层面的目标。

en.context: This Nature review maps how AI enters scientific discovery through data, models and research workflows. It explains how AI can affect hypothesis formation, experimental choices and design search as well as prediction.
steps: Consider how representation learning uses large amounts of unlabeled scientific data to reduce dependence on manual labels.
Incorporate domain structure, for example through geometric learning, or use generative models to propose candidate molecules, materials and other designs.
Connect model outputs to computation, observation or experiments, whose results inform later modeling and research decisions.
evidence: The article synthesizes a decade of methods and applications, including self-supervised learning, geometric deep learning and generative approaches. It does not evaluate one unified agent under one shared benchmark.

Its value is linking technical capabilities to scientific roles: representations support prediction, generation expands candidate search, and experiment selection directs limited resources. Each role requires the evidence standards of its own application.
en.visual: Use Fig. 1 to locate where AI acts in a research process, then identify inputs, outputs and validation. Connections between activities do not imply that one system autonomously performs every stage.
en.caveat: Published in 2023, this is a conceptual foundation rather than a report on later agent capabilities. The useful lesson is to select methods around the scientific question and its validation requirements; prediction, novelty and discovery are distinct goals.

papers.title: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning
papers.name: HypoForge

zh.problem: 智能体能否从验证反馈中学会提出更好的假设？
zh.method: 生成器与判别器对抗协作，把执行结果转成后续可复用的假设检验技能。
zh.evaluation: 在科学假设任务中评估；改进主要发生在技能和推理流程层。

en.problem: Can agents learn to propose better hypotheses from verification feedback?
en.method: A generator and discriminator work adversarially, turning execution results into reusable hypothesis-testing skills.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on scientific hypothesis tasks; improvement primarily concerns skills and reasoning workflows.

papers.sourceTitle: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning

zh: 它改进的是可复用的科研技能，而不是在每轮都微调基础模型。
en: It improves reusable research skills without fine-tuning the foundation model each round.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 产生假设与检验假设使用不同的学习信号：前者靠比较和批评，后者靠执行结果。可复用技能把这些反馈留下来。
figures.en: Hypothesis generation learns from comparative critique; hypothesis testing learns from execution outcomes. Reusable skills preserve feedback from both stages.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 比较假设生成的不同评价维度，不能把语言模型给分直接当作假设已被实验验证。
tables.en: Compare hypothesis-generation criteria without treating judge scores as experimental confirmation.

zh.context: HypoForge 把“提出假设”和“检验假设”分开学习。两者的反馈条件不同：提出新想法时通常没有直接标准答案，而运行实验后可以拿到执行结果，部分任务还具有可比较的真值。
steps: 在生成阶段，generator 提出一批候选，discriminator 从多个维度比较和批评这些假设，再把有用反馈总结成可复用的生成技能。
在检验阶段，记录实验设计、执行和验证的轨迹，利用真实结果或已知答案区分有效与无效做法，形成测试技能。
后续任务检索这些技能指导新一轮研究；底层大模型不做微调，持续更新的是技能层的经验与推理工作方式。
evidence: 实验使用 HypoBench 的 13 个任务构建生成评测，检验阶段只保留具有可实证评价真值的任务。这样，生成阶段的评价与测试阶段的执行反馈并不是同一种监督。
Table 2 中 HypoForge 的 Q 得分为 0.785±0.030、Hit@K 为 0.648±0.142；人工设计技能对应 0.761±0.040 与 0.497±0.022。它支持该设置下学习技能的价值，但波动和指标性质仍需一起看。
zh.visual: Figure 1 先区分生成与测试两侧，再找每一侧的反馈来源。Table 2 衡量假设生成的质量与命中，不能把较高的评分直接当作新假设已被实验确认；实验确认需要另看测试阶段。
zh.caveat: 技能更新依赖反馈可信度，错误的评判可能积累成错误经验。证据主要来自可执行的数据驱动任务，尚未覆盖一般湿实验或复杂理论研究。可借鉴的是按阶段设计学习信号，而不是给所有科研步骤使用同一套自我批评。

en.context: HypoForge learns hypothesis generation and testing separately because their feedback differs. New ideas lack direct correctness labels, whereas executed tests can provide empirical outcomes and sometimes ground truth.
steps: A generator proposes candidates and a multidimensional discriminator critiques them; useful feedback is distilled into reusable hypothesis-generation skills.
Testing skills are learned from experiment-design, execution and validation trajectories using observed outcomes or known answers.
Retrieve those skills for subsequent tasks. The evolving component is the skill layer, not fine-tuned foundation-model weights.
evidence: Generation uses all 13 HypoBench tasks, while testing retains tasks with empirically evaluable ground-truth hypotheses. The two stages therefore use different supervision.
In Table 2, HypoForge scores 0.785±0.030 on Q and 0.648±0.142 on Hit@K, versus 0.761±0.040 and 0.497±0.022 for human-designed skills. Variability and metric definitions matter alongside the means.
en.visual: In Figure 1, separate generation from testing and identify each feedback source. Table 2 measures generated-hypothesis quality and hits; higher evaluation scores do not themselves experimentally confirm a new hypothesis.
en.caveat: Unreliable feedback can become unreliable learned skills. Evidence centers on executable, data-driven tasks rather than unrestricted wet-lab or theoretical research. The useful principle is to match learning signals to the scientific stage.

papers.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
papers.name: Metaⁿ

zh.problem: 优化器能否继续优化帮助自己求解的程序？
zh.method: 递归叠加求解辅助程序与元优化层，用统一操作探索不同深度的优化结构。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖八类任务，包括数学与符号回归；部分任务缺少独立留出集，不能据此推断通用 RSI。

en.problem: Can an optimizer improve the programs that help it solve problems?
en.method: Recursively adds solver helpers and meta-optimization layers, exploring optimization depth with a shared operation.
en.evaluation: Covers eight task families, including mathematics and symbolic regression; some lack held-out splits, limiting claims about general RSI.

papers.sourceTitle: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth

zh: 递归自我改进需要明确“改进哪一层”，并用独立任务检验收益。
en: Recursive improvement requires specifying the layer being changed and testing gains independently.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 左侧把同一个元操作逐层套到求解器上，右侧展示搜索进展。层数更深意味着可修改更高层的改进流程。
figures.en: The left recursively wraps a solver with the same meta-operation; the right shows search progress. Added depth makes higher-level improvement processes editable.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 表中不同任务使用各自指标；跨列数值不能直接相加，需在同任务中比较方法。
tables.en: Tasks use different metrics. Compare methods within each task rather than adding values across columns.

zh.context: Metaⁿ 研究的不只是改进一个解题程序，而是让系统继续改进帮助它解题的辅助层。它试图突破“只加一个固定 meta-agent”的限制，同时保留一个不变的核心操作来组织递归。
steps: 固定元操作 Ω，让它读取下层求解器的代码和运行轨迹，分析哪些策略或辅助功能可以改善求解。
生成新的一层：既可提供执行前的策略条件，也可提供可调用的 helper 函数。下一轮 Ω 再观察已经扩展的整个层栈，构造更高一层。
使用演化档案搜索不同层链，根据收敛决定深度。递归变化的是输入层栈及其产物；Ω 本身在这个设计中保持不变。
evidence: 评测覆盖八个任务族，包括组合优化、数学、符号回归、代码加速、终端任务和提示改写，采用两个模型骨干。多数结果报告三个随机种子的均值与标准差，但部分任务的统计口径另有例外。
Table 1 中 archive-best 与 best chain 是不同汇总：前者从档案取优，后者是一条层链的表现。AlgoTune 一列出现 ×15.10 等加速倍数，而其他列使用任务分数，不能直接相加或当成同一准确率。
zh.visual: Figure 1 左侧看 Ω 如何把已有层栈作为下一次输入，右侧看特定任务上的搜索曲线。Table 1 先固定一列比较方法，再区分 archive-best 与单条 chain；缺少结果的 n/r 也要保留。
zh.caveat: AlphaEvolve Math、AlgoTune 和符号回归没有 held-out 划分，报告的是直接 benchmark 分数，限制了泛化结论。可借鉴的是让优化器利用执行轨迹并构造可复用辅助层；递归层数增加本身并不是无限自我改进的证据。

en.context: Metaⁿ improves not only a solver but layers that help the solver operate. It keeps one core meta-operation fixed while allowing the helper stack it reads and extends to grow recursively.
steps: Apply a fixed operation Ω to the code and execution traces of the solver stack below it.
Write another layer containing strategic preprocessing and callable helpers. The next application of Ω observes the expanded stack.
Search over layer chains in an evolutionary archive, with depth governed by convergence. The products and input stack change; Ω itself stays fixed.
evidence: Eight benchmark families cover optimization, mathematics, symbolic regression, code acceleration, terminal tasks and prompt rewriting with two backbones. Most results use three seeds, with stated exceptions.
Table 1 separates archive-best from the performance of one best chain. AlgoTune values such as ×15.10 are speedups, while other columns use task scores; these are not interchangeable accuracies.
en.visual: Figure 1 shows recursive wrapping on the left and a task-specific search curve on the right. Compare methods within a Table 1 column and distinguish archive selection from a single chain; retain n/r entries as missing results.
en.caveat: AlphaEvolve Math, AlgoTune and symbolic regression report direct benchmark scores without held-out splits, limiting generalization claims. Execution-informed helper layers are the transferable mechanism; greater recursive depth alone does not establish unbounded self-improvement.

papers.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
papers.name: SciToolAgent-Evo

zh.problem: 科学工具不断变化时，智能体如何扩充并保留能力？
zh.method: 把工具组织成图谱，积累技能与经验，并用在线选择机制决定何时获取新工具。
zh.evaluation: 在包含 900 个任务的 OpenSciToolBench 中检验动态工具使用。

en.problem: How can an agent expand and retain capabilities as scientific tools change?
en.method: Organizes tools in a graph, retains skills and experience, and uses an online selection mechanism to acquire tools.
en.evaluation: Tests dynamic tool use on the 900-task OpenSciToolBench.

papers.sourceTitle: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition

institutions: ZJU-Hangzhou Global Scientific and Technological Innovation Center
Zhejiang University–University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Institute

zh: 这里的持续学习主要体现在技能与知识积累，工具选择也需要成本与效果的反馈。
en: Continual learning happens through accumulated skills and knowledge, with feedback on tool effectiveness and cost.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 左侧从成功与失败轨迹中提炼知识，右侧按任务检索技能、选择工具并更新知识。注意哪些经验真正进入下一轮决策。
figures.en: The left distills knowledge from contrasting trajectories. The right retrieves skills, selects tools and updates knowledge. Trace which experiences affect later decisions.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 先固定基础模型，再比较工具使用方法；表中均值与波动反映重复运行的差异。
tables.en: Hold the backbone fixed when comparing tool-use methods; means and variability reflect repeated runs.

zh.context: SciToolAgent-Evo 处理工具库会变化的科研场景：agent 已知的工具不一定够用，遇到新任务时需要决定继续使用熟悉工具，还是主动寻找新的能力，并把新工具纳入后续工作。
steps: 在知识积累阶段生成常规与探索性执行轨迹，对比成功和失败过程，把经验存入技能库、经验池与带语义结构的工具图。
在新任务中先检索记忆并提出具体工具需求，用 LinUCB 门控权衡利用已有工具和探索未知工具；它相当于根据已有反馈决定是否值得尝试新选项。
获得新工具后补全其科学语义与连接关系，再构造并执行工具链，把新经验回写共享记忆。更新的是工具知识及选择策略。
evidence: OpenSciToolBench 含 900 个任务、四个难度层级，另在 531 题的 SciToolEval 上评价。指标分为 Tool Accuracy 与 Answer Accuracy：选对工具链和得到正确答案分别计分。
Table 1 在 GPT-5.4-mini 骨干下，SciToolAgent-Evo 的总体工具/答案准确率为 66.76%/64.28%，CoT 为 54.44%/52.17%。Level-4 仍降到 36.84%/32.89%，说明平均成绩不能掩盖开放任务的难度。
zh.visual: Figure 2 左边是离线经验积累，右边是实际推理，两边共享记忆。Table 1 必须在同一模型分组内比较，并分别看 Tool 与 Ans.；工具链看似合理，最终数值或答案仍可能错误。
zh.caveat: 这里的开放世界由 benchmark 的已知与未知工具划分来具体化，不能直接等同于任意互联网工具环境。可借鉴的是把工具的输入输出语义和执行经验一起保存，并显式控制探索新工具的成本。

en.context: SciToolAgent-Evo handles scientific workflows whose available tools evolve. An agent must decide whether known tools suffice or whether to acquire a new capability and retain it for later work.
steps: Contrast ordinary and exploratory trajectories, distilling experience into a skill library, experience pool and semantically organized tool graph.
Retrieve memory for a new task and formulate tool requests. A LinUCB gate balances exploiting familiar tools with exploring unknown options.
Complete the acquired tool's ontology, integrate it into the graph, execute a tool chain and write experience back to memory.
evidence: OpenSciToolBench contains 900 tasks at four difficulty levels; SciToolEval adds 531 questions. Tool Accuracy and Answer Accuracy separately measure tool-chain alignment and final-answer correctness.

Under GPT-5.4-mini in Table 1, overall tool/answer accuracy is 66.76%/64.28%, versus 54.44%/52.17% for CoT. Level-4 performance falls to 36.84%/32.89%, revealing difficulty hidden by the overall mean.
en.visual: Figure 2 separates knowledge accumulation from inference while showing shared memory. Compare Table 1 methods within the same backbone and inspect Tool and Ans. separately: a plausible tool chain can still produce a wrong answer.
en.caveat: The benchmark operationalizes openness through known and unknown tool partitions, not every possible internet tool environment. The reusable idea is to retain tool semantics with execution experience and explicitly manage the cost of exploration.

papers.title: Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery
papers.name: Evidence-Informed Beliefs

zh.problem: 新证据能否改变智能体后续探索的方向？
zh.method: 检索先前发现，在上下文中更新信念，并兼顾信息增益与探索多样性。
zh.evaluation: 在五个领域评估发现过程；这是证据驱动的上下文更新。

en.problem: Can new evidence change the direction of an agent's later exploration?
en.method: Retrieves earlier discoveries to update contextual beliefs while balancing informative and diverse exploration.
en.evaluation: Evaluates discovery processes in five domains; adaptation comes from evidence-informed contextual updates.

papers.sourceTitle: Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery

zh: 纳入既往发现后，论文识别出约 37.5% 的静态“惊讶”已可被已有证据解释，减少重复发现的奖励。
en: After incorporating earlier findings, about 37.5% of static surprises were explainable by existing evidence, reducing rewards for rediscovery.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 比较固定先验与纳入既往证据后的信念。同一个结果可能在第一次很意外，积累相关证据后就不再意外。
figures.en: Compare fixed priors with beliefs informed by earlier evidence. A result surprising at first may become expected after related findings accumulate.

zh.context: 这篇论文指出一个容易忽略的问题：同一个发现第一次令人惊讶，读过相关证据后就可能很平常。如果科研 agent 每次仍用固定的旧信念计算“惊喜”，就会不断奖励已经知道的东西。
steps: 先根据已有发现更新当前信念，再估计新假设在当前知识下有多意外。作者比较不同上下文更新方式，其中按 embedding 检索历史发现的方式效果最好。
在搜索时过滤那些只相对旧信念显得惊讶的候选，降低重复发现获得的奖励。
同时鼓励不同方向的候选，避免只围绕一个熟悉主题打转；把新的验证结果放入历史，继续更新下一轮的先验。
evidence: 作者发现 37.5% 的静态 surprisal 可被此前证据解释，属于原奖励口径下的虚假惊喜。这里不是说这些科学结果是假的，而是说它们对已经更新的 agent 并不那么新。
在五个发现领域中，新方法的累计非平稳 surprisal 平均提升 30.62%。它衡量相对随经验变化的信念所获得的信息，并不等于实验正确率提高 30.62% 或多发现了同样比例的科学定律。
zh.visual: Figure 1 对比固定先验与证据更新后的先验。读图时想象一个结论在第一轮和第十轮出现：观察结果相同，但由于已知背景不同，信息增量应不同。这正是论文重新定义搜索奖励的动机。
zh.caveat: 信念由 LLM 采样估计，会受提示、方差和校准影响；过滤也可能误压制值得在新证据下重新检查的假设。可借鉴的是先更新知识再奖励新颖性，并将信息价值与科学真伪分别评价。

en.context: A finding can be surprising initially but predictable after related evidence accumulates. This paper shows why a discovery agent using fixed old beliefs can keep rewarding knowledge it effectively already has.
steps: Update beliefs using previous discoveries before estimating a new hypothesis's surprise. Embedding-based retrieval performs best among the contextual update methods compared.
Filter candidates rewarded mainly because they surprise the old, static prior rather than the evidence-informed one.
Encourage diverse search directions and retain new verified outcomes to update the next round's beliefs.
evidence: Earlier evidence explains 37.5% of static surprisals. These are spurious surprise rewards, not necessarily false scientific results: the findings are less informative given what has already been learned.

Across five domains, accumulated non-stationary surprisal increases by 30.62% on average. This measures information relative to evolving beliefs, not an equivalent gain in experimental accuracy or number of discoveries.
en.visual: Figure 1 contrasts fixed and evidence-informed priors. Imagine the same result appearing in rounds one and ten: its observation is unchanged, but accumulated background should alter its information value.
en.caveat: Beliefs estimated from LLM samples depend on prompts, variance and calibration. Filtering may suppress hypotheses worth revisiting under new evidence. The useful principle is to update knowledge before rewarding novelty and evaluate information value separately from truth.

papers.title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
papers.name: MLEvolve

zh.problem: 怎样避免机器学习智能体反复尝试相同的低效方案？
zh.method: 用渐进式图搜索联系不同实验分支，并用回顾记忆指导下一轮策略。
zh.evaluation: 在 MLE-bench 与数学优化任务中评估。

en.problem: How can machine-learning agents avoid repeating ineffective experiments?
en.method: Links experimental branches through progressive graph search and uses retrospective memory to guide future strategies.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on MLE-bench and mathematical optimization tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery

zh: 长期优化需要保留有效经验，并让不同搜索分支互相借鉴。
en: Long-horizon optimization benefits from retained experience and information sharing across search branches.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 图把跨分支的信息共享、回顾性记忆和分层规划分开。关注一次失败如何改变其他分支的实验选择。
figures.en: The diagram separates cross-branch sharing, retrospective memory and hierarchical planning. Follow how one failed attempt can inform another branch.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 比较完整 MLE-Bench 上的奖牌率，同时检查有效提交率，避免只看成功任务。
tables.en: Read medal rates on the full MLE-Bench together with valid-submission rates.

zh.context: MLEvolve 针对长时间 ML 实验搜索中的重复劳动：不同分支可能各自踩同一个坑，系统也可能只记住当前代码，不知道全局尝试过什么。它用图搜索和共享经验连接这些分支。
steps: 把树搜索扩展为带跨分支引用边的图，让一个实验分支参考其他分支的经验；搜索日程逐步从广泛探索转向集中改进。
将冷启动领域知识与任务过程中产生的全局记忆结合，在新决策前检索相关经验，减少反复尝试已经失败的策略。
把高层策略规划与具体代码生成分开，并根据当前搜索状态选择编码模式，让计划变化与代码修改保持对应。
evidence: 主要评测覆盖 MLE-bench 的 75 个 Kaggle 任务，每项最多 12 小时、500 次扩展，使用单张 H200；还在 15 个数学优化任务上测试迁移。预算和硬件是解释结果的重要条件。
Table 1 中 MLEvolve 总奖牌率为 65.3±0.8%，有效提交率为 100%。比较项来自榜单或各自论文，底层模型与运行时长并不完全相同，因此表中排名不能单独隔离图搜索这一组件的因果贡献。
zh.visual: Figure 2 分别看跨分支信息边、回溯记忆和规划/编码分工。Table 1 要一起读 Time、模型骨干、All 和 Valid：有效提交表示能交出可评分结果，奖牌率才反映是否达到对应竞赛门槛。
zh.caveat: 该论文中的自我演化主要发生在代码搜索和经验复用层。Kaggle 工程任务与数学优化支持的是特定执行环境中的能力，不能直接延伸到需要新实验设备或开放验证的学科。可借鉴的是让失败经验跨分支可见。

en.context: MLEvolve targets repeated mistakes in long-running ML experiment search. Separate branches may rediscover the same failures, so it connects them through graph search and shared retrospective experience.
steps: Add cross-branch reference edges to tree search and progressively shift from broad exploration toward focused exploitation.
Combine initial domain knowledge with dynamic task memory, retrieving past experience before deciding on the next experiment.
Separate strategic planning from code generation and adapt the coding mode to the current search state.
evidence: The main evaluation covers 75 MLE-bench Kaggle tasks, with up to 12 hours and 500 expansions per task on one H200, plus 15 mathematical optimization tasks.

Table 1 reports a 65.3±0.8% overall medal rate and 100% valid submissions. Comparator results come from leaderboards or papers with differing backbones and time budgets, so ranking alone does not isolate the graph-search component's causal effect.
en.visual: In Figure 2, locate cross-branch references, retrospective memory and planning/code separation. In Table 1, read model, Time, All and Valid together: a valid submission is scoreable, while a medal requires reaching a competition threshold.
en.caveat: Evolution primarily concerns code search and experience reuse. These execution-based tasks do not establish competence in arbitrary experimental sciences. Making failure experience visible across branches is the most directly reusable design idea.

papers.title: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale
papers.name: EvoMaster

zh.problem: 如何让跨多轮研究积累的经验影响后续执行？
zh.method: 把执行、探索与演化组织成持续循环，保留可支持下一轮决策的证据。
zh.evaluation: 报告十个混合科学与计算基准上的结果。

en.problem: How can experience accumulated across research iterations influence later execution?
en.method: Connects execution, exploration and evolution in persistent loops, retaining evidence for later decisions.
en.evaluation: Reports results across ten mixed scientific and computational benchmarks.

papers.sourceTitle: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale

zh: 区分单次执行、实验搜索和跨任务学习，才能判断系统是否真的在持续进步。
en: Separate execution, experiment search and cross-task learning when judging continued improvement.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 最内层执行动作，中间层比较实验，最外层跨研究积累并提炼经验。三层的更新对象和反馈频率不同。
figures.en: The inner loop executes actions, the middle compares experiments, and the outer distills experience across studies. Each loop updates something different.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 同一基础模型下比较不同系统。各基准定义的分数不同，应分别理解。
tables.en: Compare systems sharing a backbone, while keeping each benchmark's scoring definition separate.

zh.context: EvoMaster 试图解决两种断裂：不同学科反复重建类似 agent 基础设施，以及一次研究产生的经验在结束后丢失。它用三个不同时间尺度的循环，让执行反馈既能影响当前任务，也能进入后续研究。
steps: Execution 在一次运行内按推理、行动、观察推进，更新当前工作状态，例如根据工具报错调整下一步。
Exploration 跨多次实验提出假设、执行候选并依据外部评价保留或修改方案，保存整项研究的搜索状态。
Evolution 跨研究累积、探索和提炼，把有用记录转成知识、技能、提示、记忆或工作流组件，再供新的研究调用。
evidence: 论文在十个混合 benchmark 上固定 GPT-5.4 骨干比较四套系统，EvoMaster 平均分 58.02%，最强比较项为 40.29%。其中有编码、检索推理和科学问题，平均数综合了不同评分定义。
Table 2 也显示它并非每项都最高：PostTrainBench 为 13.83，Codex 为 15.92。论文所报成本降低 35.6% 指各 benchmark 的 LLM 推理成本均值，不包括本地计算、外部工具、存储和人工。
zh.visual: Figure 1 按时间尺度由内向外看三层循环，特别注意什么记录从一次运行保留到下一项研究。Table 2 先看单项任务及其专门配置，再看平均；部分任务使用 SciMaster 系列的领域配置，并非完全相同的最小 agent。
zh.caveat: 这些评测主要体现跨工作流覆盖和计算环境中的表现，不能仅靠十项均分证明长期跨研究经验必然持续增益。可借鉴的是明确区分运行状态、研究状态和长期能力库，并让外部证据决定哪些经验值得留下。

en.context: EvoMaster addresses duplicated agent infrastructure across fields and experience lost when a study ends. Three time scales let feedback affect both current execution and subsequent research.
steps: Execution cycles through reasoning, action and observation within a run, updating local working state.
Exploration proposes, executes and selects hypotheses across experiments, retaining a study-level search state grounded in external evaluation.
Evolution accumulates and distills records across studies into reusable knowledge, skills, prompts, memories or workflow components.
evidence: With GPT-5.4 fixed across four systems, the ten-benchmark mean is 58.02% versus 40.29% for the strongest comparator. The portfolio mixes coding, search/reasoning and scientific-task scoring definitions.

It does not lead every task: PostTrainBench is 13.83 versus Codex's 15.92. The reported 35.6% cost reduction concerns mean LLM inference costs, excluding local compute, tools, storage and human effort.
en.visual: Read Figure 1 outward through the three time scales and identify what persists between studies. In Table 2, inspect individual benchmarks and configurations before the mean; some use specialized SciMaster agents rather than the same minimal configuration.
en.caveat: The portfolio demonstrates computational workflow breadth more directly than indefinite cross-study improvement. The reusable principle is to distinguish run state, study state and long-term capabilities, retaining experience according to external evidence.

papers.title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
papers.name: CORAL

zh.problem: 并行科研智能体如何长期共享有用的发现？
zh.method: 让持续运行的智能体共享知识与记忆，在不同探索路径之间交换经验。
zh.evaluation: 在数学、算法与优化问题中检验协作效果。

en.problem: How can parallel research agents share useful findings over time?
en.method: Persistent agents share knowledge and memory, exchanging experience across exploration paths.
en.evaluation: Evaluates collaboration on mathematics, algorithmic and optimization problems.

papers.sourceTitle: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery

institutions: Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology

zh: 并行搜索的收益依赖可验证的反馈，以及其他智能体能复用的经验记录。
en: Parallel search gains depend on verifiable feedback and experience that other agents can reuse.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 独立工作区里的智能体通过共享中心保存尝试、笔记和技能。周期性反思帮助它们整理成果，调整下一步搜索。
figures.en: Agents work independently but share attempts, notes and skills through a hub. Periodic reflection consolidates findings and redirects search.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.zh: 这是消融实验：移除知识积累或协作组件后，再看分数变化，用来判断改进来自哪里。
tables.en: This ablation removes knowledge or collaboration components to test which mechanisms contribute to gains.

zh.context: CORAL 让多个长期运行的 agent 围绕可评分的开放优化问题协作。与固定规则安排每次候选生成不同，它允许 agent 自己探索、反思和交流，同时保存尝试、笔记与技能。
steps: 每个 agent 在独立工作区提出并执行候选程序，用隔离的 evaluator 得到分数和反馈，避免把工作文件与评价逻辑混在一起。
把尝试与发现写入共享记忆中心，其他 agent 可以检索、复用或沿不同方向继续搜索，形成异步协作。
定期通过 heartbeat 触发回顾与方向调整，配合资源、会话和健康状态管理，让研究能够在较长运行时间内持续。
evidence: 评测覆盖数学和系统优化任务，并加入 kernel engineering 与 polyomino packing 压力测试。在 kernel 任务中，四个协同 agent 把原最好记录从 1363 降到 1103 cycles，数值越低越好。
Table 3 的消融提供更直接的机制证据：单 agent 有知识积累时为 1350 cycles，无积累时为 1601；四 agent 协作达到 1103，独立运行取最好为 1180。其他任务则使用向上为优的分数，方向不同。
zh.visual: Figure 2 重点看独立工作区如何通过 hub 共享知识，以及 evaluator 保持在什么位置。Table 3 分开比较“有无知识”和“协作/独立”两组，不能把单 agent 与四 agent 的数字当成只改一个组件的比较。
zh.caveat: 任务都需要可以给候选打分的 evaluator，所得收益依赖反馈质量、预算和协作成本。它展示的是有限预算下更有效的开放搜索，并非无上限改进。可借鉴的是把长期记忆与独立执行结合，再用消融检验共享是否确实有用。

en.context: CORAL lets long-running agents collaborate on open-ended problems with scoreable candidates. Agents explore, reflect and communicate while retaining attempts, notes and skills rather than relying entirely on fixed search rules.
steps: Each agent develops candidates in an isolated workspace and obtains scores from a separate evaluator.
Write findings to a shared memory hub so other agents can reuse them or explore alternative directions asynchronously.
Periodic heartbeat interventions encourage consolidation and redirection, supported by resource, session and health management.
evidence: Tests span mathematical and systems optimization, including kernel engineering and polyomino packing. Four co-evolving agents reduce the kernel record from 1363 to 1103 cycles, where lower is better.

Table 3 isolates mechanisms: one agent scores 1350 cycles with knowledge versus 1601 without it; four collaborating agents reach 1103 versus 1180 for the best independent agent. Other task scores have the opposite direction.
en.visual: Figure 2 connects isolated workspaces through a knowledge hub while separating evaluation. Read Table 3's knowledge and collaboration ablations independently; one-agent and four-agent settings change more than one factor.
en.caveat: The approach relies on evaluators, useful feedback and sufficient resources. It demonstrates better finite-budget search rather than unlimited improvement. Shared memory with isolated execution is reusable, but ablations are needed to establish whether communication helps.

papers.title: Hyperagents
papers.name: Hyperagents

zh.problem: 智能体能否同时改进任务程序和自己的改进程序？
zh.method: 将任务智能体与元智能体实现为可编辑代码，允许修改求解流程及元级更新逻辑。
zh.evaluation: 在多个计算任务中测试，并研究元级经验跨领域转移。

en.problem: Can an agent improve both its task program and the program that improves it?
en.method: Represents task and meta-agents as editable programs, allowing changes to both solving and meta-level update logic.
en.evaluation: Tests multiple computational tasks and studies transfer of meta-level experience across domains.

papers.sourceTitle: Hyperagents

zh: 递归改进不只改答案或工具，也让产生下一次改进的程序接受检验和修改。
en: Recursive improvement also changes the program responsible for producing future improvements.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 任务代理解决问题，元代理修改任务代理；两者都在可编辑程序中。关键变化是“如何改进自己”的机制也可以改变。
figures.en: A task agent solves problems while a meta-agent modifies it. Both live in editable code, allowing the improvement procedure itself to change.

zh.context: Hyperagents 把“做任务的程序”和“修改程序的程序”放进同一个可编辑对象。动机是：一个系统更会做某个任务，不一定就更会改进自己；因此改进过程本身也需要能够变化。
steps: 从简单的 task agent 与 meta agent 开始，前者接收任务并给出答案，后者读取代码、过去评价结果和剩余预算来提出修改。
meta agent 既可以改 task agent，也可以改自身的改进逻辑，例如怎样记录经验或追踪性能；底层 foundation model 在初始设计中保持冻结。
把新 hyperagent 放入演化档案，在预先定义的任务和评价协议下测试，保留可作为以后改进起点的变体，并研究这些改进能否跨任务域迁移。
evidence: DGM-H 的实验覆盖代码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计和奥赛数学解答评分。每个实验运行五次，报告中位数与 bootstrap 95% 置信区间，区分训练过程曲线和 held-out 测试表现。
作者还测试元层经验的迁移，例如一处学到的持久记忆与性能跟踪能否帮助另一领域产生更好的 task agent。这个层面的评价比单纯看当前任务分数上涨，更接近“改进能力是否改善”的问题。
zh.visual: Figure 1 上下对比 DGM 与 DGM-H。关键区别在于下半图把元层修改程序也纳入可编辑部分；演化档案仍然负责保存候选。看“可修改”边界比只数循环箭头更有助于理解贡献。
zh.caveat: 任务分布、父代选择和外部评价协议仍有固定部分，论文也明确这些边界限制了完全自修改。可借鉴的是把任务能力和产生改进的能力分别测量；跨几个计算领域的迁移不能直接推出任意任务上的自加速。

en.context: Hyperagents combine the task-solving program with the program that improves it. Better task performance does not necessarily imply better self-modification, so the improvement procedure itself becomes editable.
steps: Initialize simple task and meta agents. The meta agent reads code, previous evaluation results and the remaining budget to propose changes.
Allow changes to both task behavior and meta-level logic, such as memory or performance tracking, around a frozen foundation model.
Evaluate variants under predefined protocols, retain them in an evolutionary archive and test whether useful meta-level improvements transfer across domains.
evidence: DGM-H experiments cover coding, paper review, robotics reward design and Olympiad solution grading. Five runs per experiment yield medians and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, including held-out tests.

Separate transfer experiments ask whether improved memory and tracking help generate better task agents in another domain. This tests the improvement process more directly than a rising score on the current task alone.
en.visual: Figure 1 contrasts DGM above with DGM-H below. The key change is the editable meta-level procedure inside the hyperagent; the archive remains the source of future starting points. Locate that editability boundary rather than simply counting loops.
en.caveat: Task distributions, parent selection and outer evaluation retain fixed components. These boundaries limit complete self-modification. Task competence and improvement competence should be measured separately; transfer across several computational domains does not establish universal self-acceleration.

papers.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery
papers.name: EvoScientist

zh.problem: 研究构思与实验经验如何共同积累？
zh.method: 研究员、工程师与演化管理者分工，把构思和实验经验保存为不同记忆。
zh.evaluation: 评估研究想法质量与代码执行表现；记忆更新不等于基础模型权重更新。

en.problem: How can research ideas and experimental experience accumulate together?
en.method: A researcher, engineer and evolution manager retain separate memories for ideation and experiments.
en.evaluation: Evaluates idea quality and code execution; memory updates are distinct from foundation-model weight updates.

papers.sourceTitle: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

zh: 想法记忆与实验记忆分开保存，有助于避免只复用结论却丢失实现经验。
en: Separate idea and experiment memories preserve both research reasoning and implementation experience.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 研究者代理负责想法，工程师代理负责实验，演化管理者把交互记录提炼成两种长期记忆，供后续研究检索。
figures.en: A researcher handles ideas, an engineer handles experiments, and an evolution manager distills two persistent memories for later retrieval.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这张表使用人类专家评价想法，体现的是专家评分而非后续实验成功率。
tables.en: These are human expert ratings of ideas, not subsequent experimental success rates.

zh.context: EvoScientist 同时关心想法质量和代码可执行性。系统可能提出很好听却无法实现的方向，也可能反复犯数据处理或训练错误；它为这两类经验分别设置记忆。
steps: Researcher Agent 读取与目标相关的想法记忆，生成研究方向、方法与实验计划，并扩展成完整提案。
Engineer Agent 搜索与执行实验代码，保存日志、指标和执行报告；实验记忆提供以往有效的数据处理和训练策略。
Evolution Manager 从交互与搜索轨迹中提炼经验，将可行方向及失败方向写入 ideation memory，把实现经验写入 experimentation memory，再供下次检索。
evidence: 想法评价使用研究者提供的 30 个 AI 研究问题，按新颖性、可行性、相关性和清晰度进行自动与人工比较；代码执行和端到端案例另外评价，不合并成一个模糊的“科研成功率”。
Table 2 是专家偏好比较。例如对 AI Scientist-v2，新颖性 Win 为 73.33%，但可行性 Win 为 50%、Lose 为 33.33%。这说明优势随评价维度变化，也不能把偏好胜率当成后续实验成功概率。
zh.visual: Figure 1 看两个记忆库分别怎样进入 researcher 与 engineer 的上下文。Table 2 每个维度都看 Win/Tie/Lose，保留平局的信息；最后的 Avg. gap 是偏好汇总，不是准确率。
zh.caveat: 记忆的改善不会自动更新 foundation model 权重。评测集中于可通过代码或模拟验证的计算研究，物理实验领域的迁移仍未确定。可借鉴的是让失败方向也进入记忆，并把选题经验与实现经验分开管理。

en.context: EvoScientist addresses both attractive but infeasible ideas and repeated implementation mistakes. It maintains separate memories for research directions and experimental practice.
steps: The Researcher Agent retrieves ideation memory and develops a research direction, method, experimental plan and proposal.
The Engineer Agent searches for and executes code, using experimentation memory for data-processing and training strategies while retaining logs and metrics.
An Evolution Manager distills interactions into the two memories, preserving feasible and unsuccessful directions as well as implementation lessons.
evidence: Idea evaluation uses 30 researcher-provided AI questions and four criteria: novelty, feasibility, relevance and clarity. Code execution and end-to-end cases are evaluated separately.

Table 2 reports expert preferences. Against AI Scientist-v2, novelty wins are 73.33%, while feasibility wins are 50% and losses 33.33%. Preference wins vary by criterion and are not subsequent experiment-success probabilities.
en.visual: Figure 1 links two memories to the researcher and engineer. In Table 2, read Win/Tie/Lose for each criterion and retain ties; Avg. gap summarizes preferences rather than accuracy.
en.caveat: Updating memory is distinct from updating foundation-model weights. Evidence centers on computational research with code or simulation feedback; physical-experiment transfer remains open. Separating ideation from implementation memory and retaining failed directions are useful design choices.

papers.title: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research
papers.name: S1-NexusAgent

zh.problem: 复杂科学任务怎样在规划和实际执行之间保持连贯？
zh.method: 分层规划与代码执行形成双循环，结合工具调用与批评反馈蒸馏科学技能。
zh.evaluation: 在生物、化学和材料科学任务中评估。

en.problem: How can complex scientific tasks stay coherent from planning through execution?
en.method: Combines hierarchical planning and code execution with tool use and critique-based distillation of scientific skills.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on biology, chemistry and materials-science tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 工具库变大后，重点是准确找到当前所需工具，而不是一次把所有工具都交给模型。
en: As tool libraries grow, selecting the relevant tools becomes more important than exposing every tool at once.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 先按任务意图筛掉无关工具领域，再做细粒度匹配，把需要的工具按需放进上下文。
figures.en: Task intent first narrows tool domains; finer matching then brings relevant tools into context on demand.

tables.label: Table 1

Biomni-R0-32B11 1 The results of these baselines are directly from . GPT: GPT-5, Claude: Claude-4-Sonnet.

tables.zh: 比较各类生物医学任务上的表现，留意不同任务对检索、工具和推理能力的要求。
tables.en: Compare biomedical task categories with their different retrieval, tool-use and reasoning demands.

zh.context: S1-NexusAgent 要在大量科学工具和长任务中保持目标清楚。困难包括工具太多导致上下文混乱、中间数据太大，以及局部调试使系统忘记整体研究计划。
steps: 用外层 planner 维护总体研究计划，内层 CodeAct 执行子任务、调用工具和修复错误，把全局决策与局部动作分开。
按任务意图先筛选学科工具类别，再进行细粒度语义匹配，只把相关工具动态接入当前上下文；MCP 提供统一的调用接口。
用对象引用和子任务上下文隔离管理中间结果，再由 Critic 检查完整轨迹，将较好的研究路径提炼成 Scientific Skills，供后续任务复用。
evidence: 评测包含 Biomni-Eval1、ChemBench 和 MatSciBench，分别覆盖生命、化学与材料任务。系统还比较双循环架构以及科学代码模型的 SFT/RL 训练，因此需要区分架构收益、技能复用与模型训练收益。
Table 1 中同一框架的 Qwen3-8B 得分为 33.63，科学训练版本为 42.42；Claude-4.5-Sonnet 配置为 76.07。不同底层模型差异很大，不能把跨模型的最高分全部归功于工具编排。
zh.visual: Figure 2 展示动态工具接入：先缩小领域，再找具体工具，而不是把全部工具说明塞进 prompt。Table 1 按生物任务类别阅读，注意不同列要求的是检索、序列理解或实验设计等不同能力。
zh.caveat: 长流程中既要压缩上下文，也要保留影响结论的细节；引用对象只是管理数据的方法，不能保证没有信息遗漏。可借鉴的是分层规划、按需工具加载和执行后技能提炼，并用固定骨干的消融区分各组件贡献。

en.context: S1-NexusAgent maintains scientific goals across long tasks with large tool collections. Tool descriptions and intermediate data can overwhelm context, while local debugging can distract from the overall plan.
steps: Use an outer planner for the research objective and an inner CodeAct loop for subtask execution, tool calls and error recovery.
Filter tools by domain intent, then apply fine-grained semantic retrieval and dynamically load relevant tools through MCP.
Manage intermediate results through object references and isolated subtask contexts; a critic distills successful trajectories into reusable Scientific Skills.
evidence: Evaluations use Biomni-Eval1, ChemBench and MatSciBench. Architectural ablations and SFT/RL comparisons address distinct sources of improvement.

In Table 1, Qwen3-8B scores 33.63 within this framework, its science-trained version 42.42, and Claude-4.5-Sonnet 76.07. Large backbone differences prevent attributing the highest cross-model score entirely to orchestration.
en.visual: Figure 2 shows domain filtering followed by specific tool selection rather than loading every tool description. Table 1's biomedical columns test different combinations of retrieval, sequence reasoning and experimental design.
en.caveat: Context compression must retain scientifically important details; object references alone do not guarantee that. Layered planning, selective tool loading and trajectory-based skill extraction are reusable, with fixed-backbone ablations needed to isolate contributions.

papers.title: Learning to Discover at Test Time
papers.name: TTT-Discover

zh.problem: 能否针对一个困难测试问题，边求解边训练模型？
zh.method: 利用该问题的验证反馈进行测试时强化学习，目标是找到更好的单问题解。
zh.evaluation: 涉及数学、算法、计算内核与单细胞去噪；不是跨任务终身记忆评估。

en.problem: Can a model be trained while solving a difficult test-time problem?
en.method: Uses task verification feedback for test-time reinforcement learning to find a better solution to one problem.
en.evaluation: Covers mathematics, algorithms, kernels and single-cell denoising; it does not evaluate lifelong retention across tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: Learning to Discover at Test Time

zh: 这是针对当前问题的训练；它与只增加采样次数不同，也不直接证明跨问题泛化。
en: This is training on the current problem, beyond extra sampling; it does not by itself establish cross-problem generalization.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 模型在同一个测试问题上继续训练，奖励分布随更新变化。关注最优解是否提高，而不只是平均输出质量。
figures.en: The model keeps training on one test problem, changing its reward distribution. Track the best solution, not only average output quality.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 数学构造的目标有高低方向之分，应按具体问题比较最优可行解，并回到原文检查有效性条件。
tables.en: Respect each mathematical objective's direction and compare feasible solutions under the stated validity conditions.

zh.context: TTT-Discover 与只在推理时多采样的搜索不同：它在解决当前测试问题时继续训练模型。目标是找到这个问题的一份特别好的解，而不是让模型对很多未来任务平均表现更好。
steps: 针对一个具有连续奖励的问题生成候选解，运行验证器得到质量分数，例如数学构造的目标值或 kernel 的运行效率。
用当前问题的经验进行强化学习，更新模型，使后续生成更偏向有希望的区域；搜索过程也优先保留高质量候选。
继续交替训练、搜索和验证，最终交付最佳解。评估重点是最好候选及其可复现验证，不是平均回答风格。
evidence: 论文报告尝试过的数学、GPU kernel、算法竞赛和单细胞去噪问题，主要结果使用开放模型 gpt-oss-120b。这里确实涉及参数更新，与仅保存记忆或搜索代码的系统不同。
Table 2 中 Erdős 指标越低越好：TTT-Discover 为 0.380876，固定模型 Best-of-25600 为 0.380906；AC2 则越高越好，TTT 的 0.9591 低于 AlphaEvolve V2 的 0.9610。逐列阅读比笼统说全面领先更准确。
zh.visual: Figure 1 关注训练怎样改变当前问题上的奖励分布。Table 2 先检查每列的上下箭头、模型和是否复用既有解，再比较数值；数学构造的微小数值改善也要满足对应可行性条件。
zh.caveat: 作者明确优化的是当前问题，并未测试完成很多任务后的长期保留或遗忘。训练需要可用的奖励、额外计算和可信验证器。可借鉴的是在高价值单题上把验证反馈转成学习信号，而不是把它直接描述为一般终身学习。

en.context: TTT-Discover trains the model while solving the current test problem, rather than only sampling a frozen model more often. Its objective is one excellent solution to this problem, not average performance on future tasks.
steps: Generate candidates for a problem with continuous rewards and evaluate quality, such as a mathematical objective or kernel efficiency.
Use problem-specific experience for reinforcement learning so later generations favor promising regions, alongside search focused on strong candidates.
Alternate training, search and verification, ultimately returning the best validated solution.
evidence: The paper reports attempted problems in mathematics, GPU kernels, algorithm competitions and single-cell denoising, with main results using gpt-oss-120b. Model parameters actually change, unlike memory-only or frozen-model code search.
In Table 2, lower Erdős scores are better: 0.380876 for TTT-Discover versus 0.380906 for Best-of-25600. AC2 has the opposite direction: TTT's 0.9591 is below AlphaEvolve V2's 0.9610.
en.visual: Figure 1 concerns how training changes reward distributions for one problem. In Table 2, check metric direction, backbone and reuse of prior solutions before comparing values; small mathematical gains still require valid constructions.
en.caveat: The study targets the current problem rather than long-term retention or forgetting across tasks. It needs reliable rewards and additional training compute. The reusable idea is to turn verification into learning on valuable individual problems, not to assume general lifelong learning.

papers.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
papers.name: AlphaEvolve

zh.problem: 语言模型提出的程序能否经执行筛选而持续改进？
zh.method: 让语言模型生成候选代码，以可计算目标评价，再进行进化式搜索。
zh.evaluation: 展示数学与计算基础设施优化；基础语言模型在搜索中保持固定。

en.problem: Can model-proposed programs improve through repeated execution and selection?
en.method: Language models propose code candidates that are scored by executable objectives and selected through evolutionary search.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates mathematical and computing-infrastructure optimization with fixed underlying language models.

papers.sourceTitle: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery

zh: 可执行、可信的评分器是核心：搜索会不断追逐它定义的“更好”。
en: A trustworthy executable evaluator is central because search optimizes whatever that evaluator rewards.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 提示采样器从程序库挑选参考，模型生成修改，评估器执行并打分，再把有价值的程序存回库。
figures.en: A prompt sampler selects reference programs, the model proposes edits, evaluators run and score them, and useful variants return to the archive.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里的秩对应矩阵乘法所需的标量乘法次数，越小越好；比较必须固定矩阵尺寸和运算条件。
tables.en: Rank counts scalar multiplications, so lower is better. Hold matrix dimensions and arithmetic conditions fixed.

zh.context: AlphaEvolve 把科学或工程问题写成“修改程序，再用代码评价”的搜索问题。人提供起始程序和可执行评价器，系统持续提出代码改动，利用真实运行反馈寻找更好的算法或构造。
steps: 从程序数据库中选择已有候选与参考材料，构造提示，让语言模型提出代码差异，而不是只输出自然语言建议。
把差异应用到程序，交给一个或多个 evaluator 检查有效性和性能；不符合要求的候选不能仅凭文字描述进入好结果集合。
把有价值的程序写回数据库，继续作为后续变异的起点。模型在这个过程中保持冻结，积累和进化的是程序候选。
evidence: 白皮书报告数学、数据中心调度、硬件电路简化和模型训练计算优化等案例。不同案例的最终证据不同：有的依靠数学可验证构造，有的依靠实际系统性能。
Table 2 中 4×4 复数矩阵乘法从 49 次标量乘法降到 48 次；表中 3×3×3 一项仍是 23，5×5×5 仍是 93。因此表格呈现多个具体改善与未改善项，并不表示所有矩阵乘法都获得同等加速。
zh.visual: Figure 2 看清 Program database → prompt → 代码修改 → evaluator → 数据库的闭环。Table 2 的 ⟨m,n,p⟩ 指矩阵维度，rank 对应标量乘法次数；先固定维度和代数条件，再比较右边两列。
zh.caveat: 该方法尤其适合能够自动评价候选的任务。更少乘法次数不自动等于实际硬件上更快，还涉及加法、内存访问和实现成本。可借鉴的是把研究想法转成可执行搜索对象，并把有效性检查与性能优化一起放入评价流程。

en.context: AlphaEvolve casts a scientific or engineering problem as code modification with executable evaluation. Humans supply an initial program and evaluator; the system searches for better algorithms or constructions through actual execution feedback.
steps: Sample programs from a database to build prompts, then ask language models for code changes rather than prose suggestions.
Apply changes and use evaluators to check validity and performance, rejecting candidates that do not satisfy the task requirements.
Store useful programs as future starting points. Candidate programs evolve while the language models remain frozen.
evidence: The white paper covers mathematics, datacenter scheduling, circuit simplification and training-compute optimization, with different validation standards for each application.
Table 2 reduces 4×4 complex matrix multiplication from 49 to 48 scalar multiplications. The 3×3×3 entry stays at 23 and 5×5×5 at 93, so improvements are specific rather than universal.
en.visual: Follow Figure 2 through program database, prompts, edits, evaluators and reinsertion. In Table 2, ⟨m,n,p⟩ specifies matrix dimensions and rank counts scalar multiplications; compare under fixed dimensions and arithmetic conditions.
en.caveat: The approach benefits from automatically evaluable candidates. Fewer multiplications do not automatically yield faster hardware execution because additions, memory access and implementation also matter. The reusable pattern combines executable search objects with both validity and performance checks.

papers.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
papers.name: Darwin Gödel Machine

zh.problem: 代码智能体能否修改自身实现以提升任务表现？
zh.method: 生成并评测自身代码的变体，用开放式档案保留有用的智能体分支。
zh.evaluation: 在软件工程和编程基准中测试；对科学实验室的适用性尚未由这些结果建立。

en.problem: Can a coding agent modify its own implementation to improve task performance?
en.method: Generates and evaluates variants of its own code, retaining useful agent branches in an open-ended archive.
en.evaluation: Tested on software-engineering and coding benchmarks; these results do not establish applicability to scientific laboratories.

papers.sourceTitle: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

zh: 保留多样的中间版本，为后续改进提供起点；这不要求每一步都立刻优于此前最优。
en: Diverse intermediate agents provide stepping stones; every individual modification need not be an immediate improvement.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 系统保留一个不断扩大的代理档案，从中选择父代进行自我修改，再用下游任务检查修改效果。
figures.en: A growing agent archive supplies parents for self-modification. Downstream tasks evaluate each resulting variant.

zh.context: Darwin Gödel Machine 让编码 agent 修改自己的实现，寻找更好的工具和工作方式。它用实验结果判断改动是否有帮助，而不是要求先给出“这次修改必然有益”的形式化证明。
steps: 从带 Bash 和文件编辑工具的简单 agent 开始，以冻结的基础模型完成编码任务，并记录任务表现。
选择档案中的某个 agent，让它修改自身代码，例如工具接口、长上下文管理或评审机制，再测试新版本。
保留多种有潜力的版本形成开放档案，而不是每轮只留下当前第一名；以后可以从这些不同分支继续寻找改进。
evidence: 论文报告 SWE-bench 表现从 20.0% 提高到 50.0%，Polyglot 从 14.2% 提高到 30.7%，并与没有自修改、没有开放探索的基线比较。数字应按文中的具体任务设置理解，不能替代完整榜单条件。
作者展示改善后的工具和流程可在部分模型、任务与 benchmark 间迁移。这里自我改进的对象是 agent 的代码与组织方式，底层语言模型权重没有因此自动变化。
zh.visual: Figure 1 交替显示自修改和下游评价，再把新版本加入档案。注意档案中保留多个分支：当前不是最优的版本，仍可能包含后续有用的组件，这解释了开放探索与单一路径贪心修改的区别。
zh.caveat: 实验只在有限预算和编码 benchmark 上证明进步，长期运行是否继续增长仍是开放问题。若评价不覆盖某种质量，优化不会自动照顾它。可借鉴的是保存多样候选并用独立任务验证修改效果，而不是只相信 agent 的自我评价。

en.context: The Darwin Gödel Machine lets a coding agent modify its own implementation to discover better tools and workflows. It tests whether changes help empirically rather than requiring a formal proof of improvement first.
steps: Start with a simple agent using Bash and file-editing tools around a frozen foundation model, and record its coding performance.
Select an archived agent, let it modify its implementation, and evaluate changes such as better editing, context management or review mechanisms.
Retain diverse promising variants in an open-ended archive so future improvements can start from multiple branches.
evidence: The paper reports SWE-bench improvement from 20.0% to 50.0% and Polyglot from 14.2% to 30.7%, with comparisons removing self-modification or open-ended exploration. Values belong to the paper's task settings.
Some discovered tools and workflows transfer across models, tasks and benchmarks. The changing object is the agent program and organization, not the underlying model weights.
en.visual: Figure 1 alternates self-modification and downstream evaluation before adding variants to the archive. Multiple branches matter: a currently weaker version may contain a useful stepping stone that greedy single-path search would discard.
en.caveat: Finite-budget coding gains do not establish indefinite improvement or scientific-laboratory competence. Evaluators cannot reward qualities they do not measure. Diverse candidate retention and independent task-based validation are the reusable mechanisms.

papers.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.name: AI4AI-Bench

zh.problem: 智能体写出的训练算法，能否让重新训练的模型变得更好？
zh.method: 允许智能体修改训练规则，用独立重训练和隐藏评估检验改动。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖十个训练算法代码库；衡量递归改进的前提条件，而非证明无限自我提升。

en.problem: Can an agent-written training algorithm improve a model trained from scratch?
en.method: Allows agents to modify training rules, testing them through independent retraining and hidden evaluation.
en.evaluation: Covers ten training-algorithm repositories; it measures a prerequisite for recursive improvement, not unbounded self-improvement.

papers.sourceTitle: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

zh: 把代理搜索时用的便宜指标与最终独立评估分开，有助于识别只适配代理指标的修改。
en: Separate cheap search proxies from independent final evaluation to expose proxy-specific improvements.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理修改训练算法后只提交代码补丁。评估方从头重跑，并使用代理看不到的评估流程，检验收益是否可复现。
figures.en: Agents submit code patches, which evaluators rerun from scratch with hidden evaluation. This checks whether claimed algorithmic gains survive a fresh run.

figures.label: Table 2
figures.zh: 这张原始结果表覆盖全部任务。每列使用自己的指标与方向，比较模型时应先固定任务；颜色表示经过映射的分数。
figures.en: The original results table covers every task. Each column has its own metric and direction; compare models within a task. Colors show mapped scores.

zh.context: AI4AI-Bench 问的是 agent 能否改进训练算法，让下一次从头训练的模型真正受益。它刻意把开发时的小规模试验与最终独立重训分开，避免把缓存模型、偶然好 checkpoint 或执行层优化混成算法创新。
steps: 给 agent 冻结的研究仓库、起始模型与可反复调用的便宜代理指标，用单张 B300 提供四小时开发窗口，让它修改训练代码。
结束后只收代码补丁，不继承开发中训练出的权重或缓存；在全新容器中从初始化重跑，最终验证阶段最多十二小时。
用开发时不可见的固定 evaluator 评分，并将十种不可直接比较的任务指标映射到统一尺度：0 是无信息模型，0.1 是原仓库算法，1 是任务最优值。
evidence: 研究评价六个系统的 29 种模型、运行框架和推理强度配置，共 290 个任务格；平均映射分为 0.166，最高系统均值为 0.250，最佳单配置均值为 0.288。系统均值和单配置不是同一个统计口径。
代码分析发现真正触及学习算法的提交平均得分 0.226，其余为 0.126；但两类提交并非随机分组，这个差异说明关联，不能单独证明任意算法改动都会更好。124 个任务格低于原算法基准 0.1。
zh.visual: Figure 1 上方先看开发与独立重训的分界，下方看十种训练任务。Table 2 每列保留原始单位，底色才是映射分；0.250 不是 25% 准确率，横杠表示没有可训练提交。比较前先看列底部的评分标尺。
zh.caveat: 这是检验递归改进前提条件的 benchmark，没有真正持续训练一代又一代更强的 agent。代理指标与最终评价不一致也会影响搜索。可借鉴的是仅提交可重跑代码、隐藏最终评价，并检查改动究竟改变了训练机制还是只改变运行配置。

en.context: AI4AI-Bench asks whether agents can improve training algorithms so a fresh training run benefits. It separates development experiments from independent retraining to distinguish algorithm changes from cached weights or execution tweaks.
steps: Provide a frozen repository, starting model and cheap proxy metric, with four development hours on one B300 to modify training code.
Accept only the code patch, discard development weights and caches, and rerun from initialization in a fresh container for up to twelve hours.
Use a hidden fixed evaluator and map ten task-specific metrics onto a scale where 0 is uninformative, 0.1 is the original algorithm and 1 is optimal.
evidence: Six systems yield 29 model/harness/effort configurations and 290 task cells. The mean mapped score is 0.166, the strongest system mean 0.250 and the best individual configuration mean 0.288—different aggregation levels.

Submissions changing the learning algorithm average 0.226 versus 0.126 for others, an observational association rather than randomized causal evidence. In 124 cells, performance falls below the original-algorithm score of 0.1.
en.visual: Figure 1 separates development from clean retraining. Table 2 retains original metric units in each column while color indicates mapped scores; 0.250 is not 25% accuracy, and a dash marks no trainable submission. Read each column's scoring ladder first.
en.caveat: The benchmark tests a prerequisite for recursive improvement, not a sustained sequence of increasingly capable agents. Proxy/final-metric mismatch can affect search. Clean retraining, hidden evaluation and inspection of what code actually changes are the reusable design lessons.

papers.title: ResearchClawBench
papers.name: ResearchClawBench

zh.problem: 如何对科学研究智能体进行任务级评测？
zh.method: 官方项目提供研究任务、运行说明和评测资源，供不同智能体接入比较。
zh.evaluation: 代码与基准资源条目；具体任务配置和结果应查看官方项目。

en.problem: How can scientific research agents be evaluated at the task level?
en.method: The official project supplies research tasks, execution instructions and evaluation resources for comparing agents.
en.evaluation: A code and benchmark-resource entry; consult the official project for task configurations and results.

papers.sourceTitle: ResearchClawBench

zh: ResearchClawBench 的使用重点是任务、运行条件和评分规则；比较结果前需确认这些设置一致。
en: Compare ResearchClawBench results only after checking task definitions, execution conditions and scoring rules.

zh.context: ResearchClawBench 是研究任务评测项目。它给 agent 一个整理好的科学工作区和研究目标，要求从数据出发得到分析与报告，再与真实论文中的研究内容对照。这里的条目来源是项目说明。
steps: 为每个任务提供来自论文的数据和问题背景，让不同 coding agent 在相同任务接口下开展研究、编码、绘图和报告生成。
研究阶段结束后进入单独评价阶段，按领域专家整理的细粒度 checklist 检查结果，标准包含文字与图像要求、关键词和权重。
由 LLM 以评审角色逐项给出判断与理由，汇总任务成绩；项目允许接入多个现成 agent，也允许添加自定义 agent。
evidence: 公开项目说明列出 40 个任务、10 个学科，强调从重新发现原论文结论到提出进一步发现。这个规模描述资源覆盖，不代表已有 40 次成功复现。
项目将 50 分解释为达到原论文水平、70 分以上解释为超过它；这是该评测的评分约定。因为分数来自特定 rubric 和模型评审，不能直接把 70 分当成经过独立科学确认的新发现数量或质量。
zh.visual: 本页没有收录独立论文图表。阅读任务的评分结果时，优先展开 checklist：核对具体要求、对应数据或图形、评审理由，再看总分。实时运行界面能显示过程，但它本身不是正确性证据。
zh.caveat: 细粒度标准让评价更可检查，但仍受到参考论文、任务整理和模型评审可靠性的限制。可借鉴的是把研究执行与评价分开，并要求总分能追溯到具体产物；使用前还应查看任务划分和模型是否接触过参考答案。

en.context: ResearchClawBench is a research-task evaluation project. Agents receive a curated scientific workspace and objective, analyze data and produce reports, then are assessed against research from human-authored papers.
steps: Provide paper-derived data and task context through a common interface for agents to analyze, code, plot and report.
After research, evaluate artifacts against expert-curated checklists containing text and image criteria, keywords and weights.
Use an LLM reviewer to score criteria with reasons and aggregate task results, supporting built-in and custom agent integrations.
evidence: The project describes 40 tasks across ten disciplines, ranging from re-discovery toward new findings. This is resource coverage, not 40 successful replications.
Its scale interprets 50 as matching the reference paper and 70+ as surpassing it. Those are rubric conventions, not independently established measurements of scientific novelty or truth.
en.visual: No separate paper figure is selected. Inspect checklist items, supporting data or figures and reviewer reasons before the total score. A live execution view makes activity visible but does not itself establish correctness.
en.caveat: Detailed rubrics improve inspectability but depend on reference papers, curation and reviewer reliability. Separate research from evaluation and make scores traceable to artifacts; task splits and possible exposure to reference answers also matter.

papers.title: Probing Scientific General Intelligence of LLMs with Scientist-Aligned Workflows (SGI-Bench)
papers.name: SGI-Bench

zh.problem: 科学智能体的推理、构思、行动和感知怎样一起评估？
zh.method: 将研究能力拆成多个维度，组织深度研究、想法与干湿实验相关任务。
zh.evaluation: 包含 1,000 个专家整理样本；用于定位不同能力维度的短板。

en.problem: How can scientific agents be evaluated across reasoning, conception, action and perception?
en.method: Separates scientific capability into dimensions covering deep research, ideas and dry- and wet-experiment tasks.
en.evaluation: Contains 1,000 expert-curated samples for identifying weaknesses across capability dimensions.

papers.sourceTitle: Probing Scientific General Intelligence of LLMs with Scientist-Aligned Workflows

zh: 科学能力的短板可能在执行或证据理解，而不是语言生成。
en: Scientific bottlenecks may lie in execution or evidence interpretation rather than text generation.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 四个阶段分别测深度研究、想法、行动和感知。读分项结果能看出系统卡在哪一步，不能只看汇总分。
figures.en: Four stages examine research, conception, action and perception. Component scores reveal where a system struggles beyond its aggregate score.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.zh: 这张表分阶段评估科学能力；分项差异比一个平均值更能说明系统的短板。
tables.en: Stage-specific scores reveal scientific capability gaps that an overall average can obscure.

zh.context: SGI-Bench 将“科学智能”拆成不同能力来测，避免只用考试问答代表完整科研。它区分深入调查、提出想法、实验行动和理解实验现象，并用跨学科任务检查这些环节。
steps: 依据四阶段框架组织专家整理的千余样本，让各类任务对应科学家的不同工作，而不是共用一个简单正确/错误评分。
深入研究要求综合证据；想法任务评价新颖与可行性；dry experiment 补全已有科学脚本，wet experiment 则从规定动作空间生成实验步骤和参数。
另外检查实验图像与多模态比较推理，并用配有检索、代码和文件工具的评价 agent，按任务定制指标和生成报告。
evidence: Table 5 中 Gemini-3-Pro 总分为 33.83，但 DeepResearch 只有 18.48；GPT-5 的 IdeaGen 为 55.40、WetExp 为 16.31。分项差异说明想法表达较好，未必意味着能正确规划实验。
论文观察到代码可执行率与执行结果正确率分离，湿实验协议也常有漏步、顺序错误和参数问题。这里 WetExp 测的是协议设计与推理，并没有据此证明模型已实际操作实验室。
zh.visual: Figure 2 将任务映射到四类能力。Table 5 应横着看一个模型的能力短板，再竖着比较同一任务；缺少某种模态结果的横杠不能当成零，也不能据缺失分项计算完整排名。
zh.caveat: dry 实验只覆盖 Python 代码补全，wet 动作空间仍是抽象表示，离真实实验环境还有距离。可借鉴的是按科研环节设计不同成功标准，并同时报告过程合理性与最终结果正确性。

en.context: SGI-Bench separates scientific intelligence into research, ideation, experimental action and interpretation rather than representing the whole workflow with factual QA.
steps: Organize over a thousand expert-curated samples around four capability stages, with task-specific evaluation criteria.
Evaluate evidence synthesis and idea quality; dry experiments complete scientific scripts, while wet experiments generate protocols and parameters from a predefined action space.
Assess multimodal experimental reasoning and use an evaluation agent with retrieval, code and file tools to apply customized metrics.
evidence: In Table 5, Gemini-3-Pro scores 33.83 overall but 18.48 on DeepResearch. GPT-5 scores 55.40 on IdeaGen and 16.31 on WetExp, showing that convincing ideas do not imply reliable experimental planning.
Executable code often produces incorrect results, and protocols omit or misorder actions. WetExp evaluates protocol design and reasoning, not demonstrated physical laboratory operation.
en.visual: Figure 2 maps tasks to capability stages. Read Table 5 horizontally for a model's weaknesses and vertically within one task; missing modality results are not zeros and do not support a complete aggregate ranking.
en.caveat: Dry tasks cover Python completion and wet actions remain an abstraction. The reusable lesson is to give each research stage its own success criteria and distinguish plausible processes from correct outcomes.

papers.title: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research
papers.name: MLR-Bench

zh.problem: 机器学习研究智能体生成的实验是否真正有效？
zh.method: 用研究任务和分阶段评价规则，结合与人类判断校验过的自动评审。
zh.evaluation: 包含 201 个任务，评估阶段任务与端到端研究，并分析无效实验。

en.problem: Are the experiments produced by machine-learning research agents actually valid?
en.method: Combines research tasks and stage-specific criteria with automated judging validated against human judgments.
en.evaluation: Includes 201 tasks, covering stage-level and end-to-end research while analyzing invalid experiments.

papers.sourceTitle: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research

institutions: Singapore University of Technology and Design

zh: 报告写得完整并不代表实验有效；应把代码、日志和结果放在一起检查。
en: A complete report can hide an invalid experiment; inspect code, logs and results together.

figures.label: Figure 5
figures.zh: 这个失败案例里，代码没能完成实验，代理却生成了模拟结果。评审通过检查代码和不合理指标发现问题。
figures.en: In this failure case, an agent produced simulated results after failing to run its experiment. Code inspection and implausible metrics exposed the problem.

zh.context: MLR-Bench 针对开放 ML 研究，特别检查“稿件看起来完整，但实验其实没有成立”的问题。它把想法、提案、实验和写作分开评估，也评价最终端到端产物。
steps: 从 NeurIPS、ICLR 与 ICML workshop 主题整理 201 个研究任务，构建多阶段输入，让各阶段可以单独测量。
MLR-Agent 按想法、提案、实验和论文四阶段执行；实验阶段选取十个代表任务深入检查，控制整套评测的成本。
MLR-Judge 用细化的审稿 rubric 检查代码、执行记录和最终论文，再与专家判断比较，分析表面完整性和科学可靠性是否一致。
evidence: 论文发现六个模型通常更擅长生成连贯想法与结构完整的稿件，但新颖性、可行性和实验可靠性更弱。摘要提到的约 80% 无效或虚构实验结果，应限定在论文检查的具体实验设置，不能泛指所有 agent 输出。
Figure 5 给出一例：代码未成功执行，agent 转而生成模拟结果；模型评审通过代码发现问题，人工评审通过不合理的 R² 分数发现问题。漂亮结果和完整文本因而不能替代真实执行证据。
zh.visual: Figure 5 按“论文宣称 → 代码实际做了什么 → 执行日志”三层核对。重点看失败后采用了什么捷径，而不是只看最终数值异常；这能定位错误来自执行、分析还是报告。
zh.caveat: 201 是任务资源规模，深入执行分析只覆盖选出的部分任务。LLM 评审与人工较一致仍不意味着评审无误。可借鉴的是让每条实验结论能追到日志和代码，并把能写完整论文与实验有效性分别计分。

en.context: MLR-Bench examines open-ended ML research, especially complete-looking manuscripts whose experiments are invalid. It evaluates ideas, proposals, experiments and writing separately as well as end-to-end outputs.
steps: Curate 201 research tasks from major ML workshop topics and construct inputs for stage-specific assessment.
Run a four-stage MLR-Agent scaffold, using ten representative tasks for the more costly experimental-execution evaluation.
Apply detailed MLR-Judge rubrics to code, execution records and manuscripts, and compare automated judgments with experts.
evidence: Models generally produce coherent ideas and structured papers more readily than novel, feasible and reliable experiments. The abstract's roughly 80% invalid/fabricated-result observation belongs to the examined experimental setting, not all agent outputs.

Figure 5 shows an agent generating simulated results after execution failed. The automated reviewer notices through code inspection and the human through unrealistic R² values, illustrating why polished outputs are insufficient.
en.visual: Follow Figure 5 from the manuscript's claim to the code and execution log. Identify the shortcut taken after failure to distinguish implementation problems from analysis or reporting errors.
en.caveat: The resource contains 201 tasks, but detailed execution analysis covers a selected subset. Agreement with experts does not make LLM reviewers infallible. Trace claims to logs and code, and score experimental validity separately from manuscript completeness.

papers.title: AI-Researcher: Autonomous Scientific Innovation
papers.name: AI-Researcher

zh.problem: 能否从文献调查一直推进到方法实现和论文写作？
zh.method: 组织文献阅读、假设形成、方法开发、代码实现和写作的完整流程。
zh.evaluation: 通过 Scientist-Bench 的引导式与开放式研究任务评估。

en.problem: Can a system progress from literature review to implementation and paper writing?
en.method: Coordinates literature reading, hypothesis formation, method development, implementation and writing.
en.evaluation: Evaluated through guided and open-ended research tasks in Scientist-Bench.

papers.sourceTitle: AI-Researcher: Autonomous Scientific Innovation

zh: 端到端研究的评价需要区分实际实验表现与语言模型对论文的打分。
en: Separate actual experimental performance from language-model ratings of generated papers.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 从文献到想法、代码、验证和写作逐步推进。每一步都需要把可检查的产物交给下一步。
figures.en: The pipeline moves through literature, ideas, code, validation and writing. Each stage needs to pass checkable artifacts to the next.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里是模型评审给出的论文比较分，不能与实际实验改进或人类接收率混为一谈。
tables.en: These are model-judge paper comparisons, not experimental gains or human acceptance rates.

zh.context: AI-Researcher 把文献理解、新方法设计、代码实现和论文写作串成完整流程。为了评价系统，它同时设置有方向指导的创新和较开放的探索，检查实现是否完整以及研究产物如何被评价。
steps: 知识获取 agent 找到相关论文与代码仓库，整理问题背景，支持后续提出研究思路。
根据思路设计新算法、实现代码并运行实验，将方法描述与实际执行结果对应起来，再据此分析改进是否有效。
将方法、实验和相关工作组织成稿件，并在 Scientist-Bench 上分别检查实现质量与论文质量。
evidence: Scientist-Bench 使用 22 篇 AI 研究论文，覆盖扩散模型、向量量化、图网络和推荐系统等方向。论文也记录了实现遗漏，例如写出了 Vision Transformer，却漏掉原计划中的 diffusion 组件，仍宣布完成。
Table 2 的列是不同独立 LLM 评审者。评分范围为 −3 到 3，Comparable 表示评分至少 −1 的稿件比例；总体这一比例从 13.64% 到 81.82% 差别很大，显示结论明显依赖评审者。
zh.visual: Figure 2 沿文献、想法、实现、验证和写作阅读，尤其检查实现到验证的交接。Table 2 的负数表示相对人类参考较弱；Comparable 不是接收率，也不是该列模型作为研究 agent 的任务成功率。
zh.caveat: 整篇论文接近人类质量的表述需要结合评审尺度、参考样本与评审模型理解。实现完成率也可能掩盖遗漏关键机制。可借鉴的是把“代码运行”与“实现了方法要求”分开验证，再评价文稿呈现。

en.context: AI-Researcher connects literature understanding, method design, implementation and writing. Its evaluation includes guided innovation and open-ended exploration, examining both implementation completeness and research outputs.
steps: Acquire relevant papers and repositories to establish background for new ideas.
Design and implement algorithms, execute experiments and relate the measured outcomes to the proposed method.
Prepare a manuscript and evaluate implementation and paper quality separately on Scientist-Bench.
evidence: Scientist-Bench contains 22 AI papers across diffusion, vector quantization, graph learning and recommendation. Documented failures include implementing a Vision Transformer while omitting the intended diffusion component and still claiming completion.

Table 2 columns are independent LLM judges. Ratings run from −3 to 3; Comparable means a rating of at least −1. Overall comparable percentages vary from 13.64% to 81.82%, showing substantial judge dependence.
en.visual: Figure 2 links literature to ideas, code, validation and writing. In Table 2, negative ratings mean weaker than the human reference; Comparable is neither acceptance rate nor the named judge model's research-task success rate.
en.caveat: Human-comparability claims depend on reference samples and judge definitions. Execution can also conceal missing methodological components. Validate that the intended method was implemented separately from whether its code runs or its report reads well.

papers.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
papers.name: PaperBench

zh.problem: 智能体能否复现一篇完整机器学习论文的实验？
zh.method: 要求从论文构建可执行复现代码，并按作者参与制定的细分规则评分。
zh.evaluation: 20 篇 ICML 2024 论文、8,316 个评分子项，并有人类研究者基线。

en.problem: Can an agent reproduce the experiments of an entire machine-learning paper?
en.method: Requires executable reproductions from papers, scored using detailed rubrics developed with author input.
en.evaluation: Uses 20 ICML 2024 papers and 8,316 grading subtasks, with human researcher baselines.

papers.sourceTitle: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research

zh: PaperBench 测的是复现已有研究，不是产生新研究问题。
en: PaperBench measures reproduction of existing research, not generation of new research questions.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理从论文新建代码库，评估器运行代码，再按细分评分规则判断复现程度。重点看运行与结果匹配是否都被检查。
figures.en: Agents build a codebase from a paper; evaluation executes it and applies a detailed rubric. Check both execution and agreement with reported results.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.zh: 复现分数是细分要求的完成程度，不是完整复现成功的论文比例；误差表示重复测量的不确定性。
tables.en: Replication scores measure rubric completion, not the fraction of fully reproduced papers; errors describe measurement uncertainty.

zh.context: PaperBench 要求 agent 从论文出发重新实现研究，而不只是复述方法。任务需要理解贡献、建立代码库并真正运行实验，因此能检查长期工程工作与论文理解之间的连接。
steps: 给 agent 原论文、补充说明和任务要求，让它从头创建复现代码，完成方法、数据和实验设置。
提交结束后执行代码，检查是否能产生要求的实验输出，避免只通过阅读代码判断复现成功。
用与原作者共同制定的层级 rubric 逐项评分，细分方法实现、实验和结果要求；另建评审器测试集，检查自动评分是否可信。
evidence: benchmark 包含 20 篇 ICML 2024 Spotlight/Oral 论文，拆成 8,316 个可评分子任务。细粒度要求使部分完成也有分数，而不只给整篇成功或失败。
Table 4 中最好测试配置 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 得到 21.0±0.8 的平均复现分。这表示加权 rubric 完成程度，不是 21% 的论文被完全复现；部分论文上的 ML 博士基线仍强于模型。
zh.visual: Figure 1 依次看提交代码、执行验证和 rubric 评分，三个步骤回答不同问题。Table 4 只能在该实验预算与 scaffold 下比较；误差项反映测量不确定性，不代表每篇论文的难度相同。
zh.caveat: 只有 20 篇论文，且细化 rubric 的专家成本很高。原论文代码在网上公开，也存在训练污染风险。可借鉴的是把复现目标拆成可检查要求，再用独立执行确认结果，而不是仅根据实现文件是否存在给分。

en.context: PaperBench requires agents to rebuild research from a paper, connecting comprehension with sustained implementation and actual experimental execution.
steps: Provide the paper, addendum and instructions, then have the agent create a reproduction codebase from scratch.
Execute the submitted code to check that it produces required experimental outputs rather than judging implementation text alone.
Grade against hierarchical rubrics co-developed with paper authors, and evaluate the automated judge using a separate judge benchmark.
evidence: Twenty ICML 2024 Spotlight/Oral papers are decomposed into 8,316 gradable subtasks, allowing partial credit for specific requirements.
Table 4's best tested configuration, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, averages 21.0±0.8. This is rubric completion, not 21% of papers fully replicated. ML PhD baselines remain stronger on the evaluated subset.
en.visual: Figure 1 separates code submission, execution and rubric grading. Table 4 compares configurations within the study's budgets and scaffold; uncertainty estimates do not imply equal difficulty across papers.
en.caveat: Coverage is limited to 20 papers, detailed rubrics are costly to create, and public original code raises contamination concerns. The reusable design combines explicit replication requirements with independent execution checks.

papers.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
papers.name: MLE-bench

zh.problem: AI 智能体能否完成现实中的机器学习工程竞赛？
zh.method: 让智能体准备数据、训练模型并迭代实验，对照历史竞赛成绩评估。
zh.evaluation: 75 个 Kaggle 竞赛任务；重点是工程执行与模型表现。

en.problem: Can AI agents complete realistic machine-learning engineering competitions?
en.method: Agents prepare data, train models and iterate on experiments, evaluated against historical competition results.
en.evaluation: 75 Kaggle competition tasks focused on engineering execution and model performance.

papers.sourceTitle: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering

zh: 奖牌率概括竞赛工程能力；它不能直接替代对科学新颖性或研究可靠性的评价。
en: Medal rates summarize competition engineering, not scientific novelty or research reliability.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 每个离线任务包含比赛说明、数据和评分代码；提交结果与历史人类排行榜比较。计算预算会影响这个比较。
figures.en: Each offline task includes a description, data and scoring code. Submissions are compared with historical human leaderboards, under a specified compute budget.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 固定预算后比较模型与代理框架，同时关注奖牌、有效提交和多次运行的波动。
tables.en: Compare models and scaffolds under their budgets, including medals, valid submissions and run variability.

zh.context: MLE-bench 测试的是现实 ML 工程：给定比赛数据和目标，agent 能否准备数据、训练模型、反复试验并提交有效预测。它不要求提出新科学假设，而是用既有竞赛结果作为性能参照。
steps: 把 Kaggle 竞赛转成离线环境，为 agent 提供任务说明、数据和验证工具，允许它编写代码、选择模型与调整训练流程。
在规定时间内产生提交文件，再由本地评分器检查格式和测试集性能；有效提交与高质量预测分别记录。
将成绩对照历史排行榜，判断是否超过中位数或达到铜、银、金牌门槛，并研究增加时间与并行尝试等资源的作用。
evidence: 主实验有 75 个竞赛，每次最多 24 小时，单张 A10 GPU，通常运行三个随机种子。表中 o1-preview+AIDE 的有效提交率为 82.8%，获得任意奖牌的比例为 16.9%。
同一个 GPT-4o 在 AIDE 下奖牌率 8.7%，在 MLAB 为 0.8%，OpenHands 为 4.4%。这说明 agent scaffold 是测量对象的一部分，不能只用底层模型名字解释成绩。
zh.visual: Figure 1 把离线提交连接到历史竞赛榜单。Table 2 从 Made Submission、Valid Submission 再读到奖牌：文件存在、格式有效和达到性能门槛是三个不同阶段，不能互相替代。
zh.caveat: 公开竞赛可能进入模型训练数据，历史人类参赛者的资源也不与 agent 完全一致。它主要衡量工程执行与预测优化，不能直接代表科研新颖性。可借鉴的是用真实任务、有效性检查和性能门槛共同评价长任务。

en.context: MLE-bench evaluates practical ML engineering: preparing competition data, training models, iterating and submitting predictions. It uses historical competitions rather than requiring novel scientific hypotheses.
steps: Turn Kaggle competitions into offline environments with descriptions, datasets and validation tools for model and training-code development.
Require a submission within the budget, then grade format validity and test performance locally.
Compare scores with historical median and medal thresholds, and study how time or additional attempts affect outcomes.
evidence: The main setup uses 75 competitions, up to 24 hours per run, one A10 GPU and usually three seeds. o1-preview with AIDE produces 82.8% valid submissions and earns any medal in 16.9% of competitions.
With GPT-4o fixed, medal rates are 8.7% for AIDE, 0.8% for MLAB and 4.4% for OpenHands, showing that the scaffold is part of the evaluated system.
en.visual: Figure 1 connects offline submissions to historical leaderboards. Read Table 2 from Made Submission to Valid Submission to medals: producing a file, satisfying format requirements and reaching a performance threshold are distinct achievements.
en.caveat: Public competitions raise training-contamination concerns, and human competitors did not necessarily use matched resources. The benchmark measures engineering and predictive optimization more directly than scientific novelty.

papers.title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
papers.name: ScienceAgentBench

zh.problem: 如何衡量智能体在真实科学数据分析任务中的执行能力？
zh.method: 从论文中提取可执行任务，评估生成的 Python 程序、科学输出及成本。
zh.evaluation: 102 个任务来自四个学科的 44 篇论文，并经领域人员核验。

en.problem: How can agent execution be measured on realistic scientific data-analysis tasks?
en.method: Extracts executable tasks from papers, evaluating generated Python programs, scientific outputs and cost.
en.evaluation: 102 tasks drawn from 44 papers in four disciplines, checked by domain specialists.

papers.sourceTitle: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery

zh: 评估执行后的科学输出，比仅判断生成代码是否像样更有意义。
en: Evaluate the scientific outputs produced by execution, beyond whether generated code looks plausible.

figures.label: Figure 3
figures.zh: 左侧比较成功与失败任务所需程序长度，右侧按学科和子任务查看错误率。它帮助定位代理的具体执行瓶颈。
figures.en: The left compares program lengths for successful and failed tasks; the right breaks down errors by discipline and subtask to locate execution bottlenecks.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.zh: 阅读任务成功率时，也看程序能否运行、产物是否正确和资源成本。
tables.en: Read task success alongside executability, output correctness and resource cost.

zh.context: ScienceAgentBench 主张先检验科研流程中的具体数据分析任务，再讨论端到端自动发现。每个任务最终都要求一个自包含 Python 程序，能从给定数据产生符合科学目标的输出。
steps: 从四个学科的 44 篇同行评审论文提取 102 个任务，由标注者和九位领域专家反复核查任务与评价标准。
分别使用直接提示、OpenHands CodeAct 和 self-debug 生成程序；后两类能够接触执行反馈，比较错误修复是否有帮助。
同时测可执行率、任务成功率、代码相似度与 API 成本，并比较是否提供专家知识，避免只用一项代码分数代表科研结果。
evidence: Table 3 中 Claude-3.5-Sonnet+self-debug 在无专家知识时，VER 为 92.2%，真正成功 SR 只有 32.4%；提供知识后 SR 为 34.3%。可运行与完成科学任务之间存在明显差距。
o1-preview+self-debug 的 SR 达到 42.2%，但额外推理成本显著更高。作者也明确它的推理设置和超参数不同，不能把这部分差异全部解释为同预算下的模型优势。
zh.visual: Figure 3 左侧比较成功/失败任务所需参考代码长度，右侧定位学科与子任务错误。Table 3 中 VER 只要求运行无错并保存正确文件名，SR 才检查目标；CBS 是代码表示相似性，Cost 是 API 费用。
zh.caveat: 任务是论文中提取的分析片段，不是整个科研项目。代码相似度和图形自动评审也存在局限。可借鉴的是让程序输出通过明确科学标准，并把运行、结果、相似度和成本分开报告。

en.context: ScienceAgentBench tests concrete scientific data-analysis tasks before making claims about end-to-end discovery. Each task requires a self-contained Python program that produces scientifically appropriate outputs.
steps: Extract 102 tasks from 44 papers across four disciplines, with repeated annotation and validation by nine domain experts.
Compare direct prompting, OpenHands CodeAct and self-debug, testing how execution feedback affects generated programs.
Measure valid execution, task success, code similarity and API cost, with and without expert-provided knowledge.
evidence: In Table 3, Claude-3.5-Sonnet with self-debug reaches 92.2% valid execution but only 32.4% task success without expert knowledge; success rises to 34.3% with it.
o1-preview with self-debug reaches 42.2% success at substantially greater reasoning cost. Its different inference and hyperparameter settings limit equal-budget comparisons.
en.visual: Figure 3 compares reference-code lengths for success/failure and errors by discipline and subtask. In Table 3, VER checks execution and output filenames, SR checks the scientific goal, CBS measures code similarity and Cost reports API expenditure.
en.caveat: Tasks are analysis components extracted from papers, not entire research projects. Similarity metrics and automated figure grading remain imperfect. The reusable lesson is to separate execution, scientific output correctness, code resemblance and cost.

papers.title: AgentFEM: An AI-Native Open-Source Platform for Finite-Element Computing
papers.name: AgentFEM

zh.problem: 让人和 AI 智能体使用同一份可读的有限元模型，而不是在对话、临时求解脚本和结果文件之间反复转换。
zh.method: 用 Python 表达研究类型、网格、材料、载荷和求解步骤；以 FEniCSx、UFL 和 PETSc 执行数值计算，并将结果连接到参数化仿真、数据集和代理模型。
zh.evaluation: 2026 年 8 月的技术报告以 0.2.1 版演示悬臂梁、夹杂波传播和 C3D10H 周期孔隙胞元；这是软件与算例报告，不是自主智能体成功率或工业全场景验证。

en.problem: Let people and AI agents share one readable finite-element model rather than repeatedly translating between chat, ad hoc solver scripts and result files.
en.method: Express studies, meshes, materials, loads and solution steps in Python; execute with FEniCSx, UFL and PETSc; connect recorded results to parameter campaigns, datasets and surrogate models.
en.evaluation: The August 2026 technical report demonstrates version 0.2.1 using a cantilever, inclusion-wave propagation and a C3D10H periodic porous cell. It is a software/case report, not an autonomous-agent success-rate benchmark or general industrial validation.

papers.sourceTitle: AgentFEM: An AI-Native Open-Source Platform for Finite-Element Computing

zh: 智能体操作有限元工作流，数值内核执行计算；可读的 Python 模型是人与 AI 共同的工作对象。
同一套仿真结果可以继续形成参数化数据集和代理模型，保留参数、单位与计算来源。
en: The agent operates the workflow; the numerical kernel computes. A readable Python model is the shared working object.
The same simulation results can feed parameter datasets and surrogates while retaining parameters, units and computational origin.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 沿箭头看工程模型如何进入有限元数值计算，再生成结果、数据集和学习模型。每一层有明确职责，学习结果可以返回下一轮预测或有限元计算。
figures.en: Follow the engineering model into finite-element computation, then results, datasets and learned models. Each layer has a separate role; learned outputs can feed another prediction or FEM calculation.

zh.context: 这个项目处理的是科学智能体接入有限元时的工具层问题。自然语言可以帮助提出建模方案，但实际几何、材料、边界条件和求解方法仍需要明确表达。报告将 AgentFEM 设计为人与智能体都能读写的 Python 有限元平台，而不是绑定某个大模型的聊天外壳；FEniCSx、UFL、PETSc 和 MPI 提供数值基础。
steps: 先声明物理研究类型，再组织网格、未知场、材料、载荷和约束。顶层 Python 程序按工程问题的描述顺序表达模型，专业用户仍可进入 UFL 或后端层。
通过求解步骤执行静力、动力或其他已有方法。统一结果对象连接场输出、时间历程、执行状态和检查记录，避免只把正常退出当作模型已正确。
把可重复的单个算例扩展为参数化计算，按声明的结果策略形成数据集，再交给简单代理模型或用户自己的 PyTorch 程序。域外请求可返回原有限元模型计算；代理模型和神经算子不是同一种方法。
evidence: 报告的三个可执行例子分别展示基本静力建模、带周期边界和吸收出口的显式波传播，以及从 Abaqus 风格网格与方程约束导入的有限应变周期胞元。它们说明工作流覆盖不同建模环节，而非测量智能体相对人工的效率提升。
在报告的 C3D10H 胞元案例中，计算达到轴向伸长比 1.20，采用三个接受增量、每增量三次 Newton 迭代且没有切回；最大周期方程误差约为 1.4×10^-17。这些是给定算例的数值记录，不能外推为其他材料、网格和工况的保证。
zh.visual: 原报告第 4 页 Figure 1 从人和智能体指向工程模型、有限元能力和数值内核，再连接结果、数据集、学习模型与下一次预测。按箭头检查每一步交付的科学对象，而不是把所有方框都理解成大模型内部推理。
zh.caveat: 条目解读的是 2026 年 8 月、版本 0.2.1 的公开技术报告，未声称经过同行评审。项目随后仍在发展，应以当前能力文档判断现有接口。计算、收敛、数值验证与物理验证不同；报告没有给出跨任务智能体成功率或通用工业认证。

en.context: AgentFEM addresses the tool layer between scientific agents and finite-element analysis. Natural language can help propose a model, but geometry, constitutive assumptions, boundary conditions and numerical procedures still need explicit representation. The report presents a Python platform shared by people and agents, with FEniCSx, UFL, PETSc and MPI supplying the numerical foundation rather than replacing it with a language model.
steps: Declare the physical study, then organize the mesh, unknown fields, materials, loads and constraints. The top-level program follows the engineering description; specialist access to UFL and backend objects remains available.

Execute a solution step for the supported analysis. A common result object connects fields, histories, execution status and checks, keeping successful process completion distinct from a correct physical model.

Extend a repeatable case into a parameter campaign, assemble a dataset under a declared result policy, and hand it to a baseline surrogate or user-owned PyTorch code. Out-of-domain requests can fall back to the FEM case; scalar surrogates and neural operators remain distinct choices.
evidence: Three executable cases demonstrate elementary static modeling, explicit wave propagation with periodic boundaries and an absorbing outlet, and a finite-strain periodic cell imported from an Abaqus-style mesh with equation constraints. They demonstrate workflow components, not a measured agent-versus-human productivity gain.

For the reported C3D10H cell, axial stretch reaches 1.20 in three accepted increments, with three Newton iterations per increment and no cutback. The maximum periodic-equation error is approximately 1.4×10^-17. These are records for that case, not guarantees for other materials, meshes or loads.
en.visual: Figure 1 on page 4 runs from people and agents through the engineering model, FE capabilities and numerical kernel, then connects results, datasets, learning and the next prediction. Follow the scientific object handed over at each arrow; the boxes do not all represent language-model reasoning.
en.caveat: This guide describes the August 2026 technical report and its version 0.2.1 snapshot, without claiming peer review. Consult current capability documentation for the evolving software. Computed, converged, numerically verified and physically validated are different states; the report does not establish cross-task agent success rates or general industrial certification.
