papers.title: Harnessing agent memory to build lifelong AI partners for materials scientists
papers.name: Lifelong Materials Memory

zh.problem: 材料模拟中的经验能否跨会话持续复用？
zh.method: 保存事实、可执行技能和失败防护规则，让后续任务调用结构化记忆。
zh.evaluation: 涉及工具问答、状态方程及 13 个模拟流程；不更新基础模型权重。

en.problem: Can experience from materials simulations be reused across sessions?
en.method: Stores facts, executable skills and failure guards as structured memory for later tasks.
en.evaluation: Covers tool questions, equations of state and 13 simulation workflows, without changing foundation-model weights.

papers.sourceTitle: Harnessing agent memory to build lifelong AI partners for materials scientists

institutions: Materials Innovation Institute for Life Sciences and Energy (MILES), HKU-SIRI

zh: 在论文的 MatTools 实验中，三轮记忆演化把 GPT-5.2 的任务成功率从 62.3% 提高到 75.4%，过程中模型参数保持不变。
en: Across three memory-evolution rounds on MatTools, the paper reports GPT-5.2 task success rising from 62.3% to 75.4% with model weights fixed.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从文献、成功经验和失败教训形成记忆，再把记忆带入下一次材料研究。关注记忆如何经过整理后影响工具使用。
figures.en: Literature, successful attempts and failures become memory for later materials research. Trace how curated experience changes tool use.

zh.context: 这篇材料记忆论文把研究经验当成长期资产：哪些脚本可用、某种计算怎样失败、下次提交任务前应检查什么，不应随一次对话或更换模型而消失。它以材料模拟为例区分事实记忆与可执行技能。
steps: 从工具调用、计算任务与日志中收集经验，把观察结果、失败原因、适用条件和验证方式写成可检查的事实记录。
将可重复执行的计算流程整理成技能，例如先结构弛豫再做性质计算，保留作业来源和 HPC 执行说明。
新任务开始时检索相关事实与技能，根据实际运行更新它们；可以迁移这些记忆到不同模型，而不需要更新模型权重。
evidence: MatTools 包含 49 个问题与 138 个可执行子任务。Figure 1e 展示完整记忆演化使 GPT-5.2 在三轮中从 62.3% 到 75.4%；这是特定配置的跨轮曲线，不应与摘要中不同对照的提升口径混合。
元素固体状态方程实验把一次波函数初始化失败变成运行前检查，Correct/Partial/Error 从 22/1/4 变成 25/2/0。另有 13 个实际模拟流程，到第三轮总 token 负担约减半，工具调用也减少，同时检查物理输出。
zh.visual: Figure 1d 具体看一条 fact-memory 和 skill-memory 包含什么：不仅有结论，还有失败诊断、建议动作及计算顺序。1e 再看完整演化、仅记忆和仅沙箱的曲线，区分保存记录与持续整理记录的作用。
zh.caveat: 这些结果来自计算材料任务，并非多年跨学科的终身研究实验。旧经验还需要适用条件，否则一个失败检查可能错误阻止新任务。可借鉴的是保存失败边界和来源，把经验做成可迁移、可复核的材料。

en.context: This materials-science study treats experience as a durable asset: working scripts, failure diagnoses and pre-execution checks should survive a conversation or model change. It separates inspectable facts from executable skills.
steps: Collect observations, failure causes, applicability conditions and validation records from tool calls and job logs.
Package repeatable calculation procedures as skills, retaining provenance and execution notes such as relaxation before property calculations.
Retrieve and revise facts and skills for later tasks, allowing memory migration across models without weight updates.
evidence: MatTools contains 49 questions and 138 executable subtasks. Figure 1e shows GPT-5.2 improving from 62.3% to 75.4% over three rounds with full memory evolution, a specific comparison distinct from other abstract-level baselines.

Equation-of-state outcomes move from 22/1/4 to 25/2/0 Correct/Partial/Error after an initialization failure becomes a pre-run guard. Thirteen simulation workflows roughly halve aggregate token burden by round three while checking physical outputs.
en.visual: Inspect Figure 1d for what fact and skill records contain: diagnosis, recommended action, calculation order and provenance. In e, distinguish full memory evolution from memory-only and sandbox-only variants.
en.caveat: These are computational materials experiments, not a multi-year demonstration of unrestricted lifelong research. Memories need applicability conditions to avoid misusing old lessons. Portable, inspectable failure knowledge is the central design contribution.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Designs Physically Reasoned White-Box Fluid Control
papers.name: White-Box Fluid Control

zh.problem: 如何找到可读、可分析的流体控制策略？
zh.method: 在模拟反馈下进化显式控制器代码，用可检查程序表示策略。
zh.evaluation: 研究游动与流体控制，并测试从二维到三维的迁移。

en.problem: How can fluid-control policies remain readable and analyzable?
en.method: Evolves explicit controller code using simulation feedback, keeping the policy as an inspectable program.
en.evaluation: Studies swimming and fluid control, including transfer from two to three dimensions.

papers.sourceTitle: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Designs Physically Reasoned White-Box Fluid Control

zh: “白盒”体现在控制器是可查看的程序；还应检查它在不同流动条件下是否有效。
en: The controller is inspectable code; also check whether its behavior transfers to changed flow conditions.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 设计代理与控制程序分别维护候选种群，知识架保存经验。每次迭代既可以换控制策略，也可以改产生策略的代理。
figures.en: Design agents and control programs maintain separate populations, supported by a knowledge shelf. Iterations can change both policies and the agents designing them.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 策略保持固定，只改变环境条件。它检验的是迁移能力，而不是在新环境重新训练后的成绩。
tables.en: Policies stay fixed while environmental conditions change, testing transfer rather than retraining performance.

zh.context: 这项流体控制研究让 agent 写出可直接阅读的控制程序，控制只有两个关节的游动体在变化水流中到达目标。语言模型负责离线设计，最终执行控制的是独立代码。
steps: 从没有目标感知的推进控制器开始，agent 结合轨迹、身体状态、目标信息与流场观察提出控制逻辑和参数修改。
固定 CFD 评价器运行新控制器，返回分数和多模态日志；agent 从这些反馈积累推进、转向与减轻负载等设计经验。
共同维护控制器种群和设计 agent 的知识种群，选择并继承较好的变体。部署时无需继续调用语言模型或神经网络来决定每个动作。
evidence: 控制器只能指定两个关节的角加速度，不能直接命令位置或受力，所以运动必须通过身体变形与流体响应产生。作者测试目标位置、尾流、圆柱数量和入流速度变化，并研究 2D 经验对 3D 适配的帮助。
Table 1 固定控制器后改变目标位置：原场景两种方法都 5/5 到达；三个新目标条件下 agent 控制器均 5/5，DRL 比较项均 0/5。这是这些具体迁移条件的对照，不是所有流体环境的保证。
zh.visual: Fig. 1 看设计 agent 与控制代码两套候选如何共同演化，同时 CFD 接口保持固定。Table 1 先看目标坐标，再看 Reach；时间和得分列描述成功轨迹的其他性质，不能代替到达率。
zh.caveat: 白盒代码便于分析，但可读不等于已给出完整稳定性证明。证据来自指定仿真与有限重复测试，真实机器人还会遇到模型误差。可借鉴的是把设计时复杂推理与运行时简单控制分离，并在冻结策略后测试环境变化。

en.context: This study uses agents to write explicit controllers for a two-joint swimmer navigating changing flows. Language models design the policy offline; standalone code performs control during deployment.
steps: Start from a target-blind propulsive controller and revise logic using trajectories, body state, target diagnostics and flow observations.
Evaluate candidates through a fixed CFD interface returning scores and multimodal logs, then accumulate lessons about propulsion and steering.
Co-evolve controller candidates and inherited design knowledge. The final policy runs without language-model or neural-network inference.
evidence: Only two joint angular accelerations can be commanded, so propulsion emerges through deformation and hydrodynamics. Tests vary targets and flow geometry, with additional 2D-to-3D adaptation.
In Table 1, both methods reach the original target 5/5 times. At three changed targets, the agent controller reaches 5/5 and the DRL comparator 0/5, under those specific frozen-policy tests.
en.visual: Fig. 1 co-evolves design agents and controller code around a fixed CFD evaluator. In Table 1, read target coordinates and Reach first; time and score columns describe additional trajectory properties.
en.caveat: Readable code is not a complete stability proof. Simulation results and limited repeats do not eliminate real-world model mismatch. Separating offline design from simple runtime control and testing frozen policies under changed conditions are useful principles.

papers.title: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
papers.name: GRAFT-ATHENA

zh.problem: 科学计算方法的搜索空间能否随经验共同扩展？
zh.method: 用分解式概率树表达方法选择，积累以往问题的经验并扩充可选动作。
zh.evaluation: 在物理信息机器学习、逆问题与数值求解中检验。

en.problem: Can the search space of scientific-computing methods expand with experience?
en.method: Represents method choices with factored probabilistic trees, learning from past problems and expanding available actions.
en.evaluation: Tested on physics-informed learning, inverse problems and numerical solvers.

papers.sourceTitle: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms

zh: 科学计算的方法选择有结构约束，不能把所有工具当成任意可拼接的积木。
en: Scientific methods have structural dependencies; tools cannot always be combined arbitrarily.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先把求解器知识组织成图，再在满足依赖约束的方法链中搜索。验证结果反过来修正可选方案。
figures.en: Solver knowledge becomes a graph, enabling search over method chains that respect dependencies. Validation feeds back into the available choices.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 各物理学习问题使用不同评估设置，逐项比较误差与约束，不能直接把不同问题的数值排名混合。
tables.en: Compare errors and constraints within each physics task; values from different problems are not interchangeable.

zh.context: GRAFT-ATHENA 把数值方法选择写成结构化决策：采用哪种表示、损失、优化器或正则化，各选项之间又有哪些兼容条件。它希望旧问题的求解经验能帮助新问题，而不是每题从头试。
steps: 将问题与方法的依赖图转成因子化树，一条路径对应一种具体问题或方法组合；保留选择之间的规则，同时降低表示规模。
把新问题编码成指纹，检索相似旧问题及其回报，用这些邻居为当前方法搜索提供起点和合理的预期观测。
策略团队提出组合，实现团队写代码，诊断团队根据运行反馈修改选择或增加新动作。成功与失败记录都回到长期知识与经验中。
evidence: 实验覆盖物理信息学习、逆问题与数值求解，包括典型 PDE、Apollo 高速流动重建和血液流变案例。框架也允许根据文档或方法论文扩展自己的动作词表。
Table 1 在 Burgers 任务给出相对 L2 误差 1.48×10⁻⁹，Helmholtz 为 6.20×10⁻¹⁰；但 Poisson 的 MSE 4.51×10⁻¹³ 高于表中另一 agent 的 3.95×10⁻¹³。不同误差定义不能混读成所有指标一致领先。
zh.visual: Figure 1 可按“图扩展 → 长期记忆 → 问题编码 → 相似任务热启动 → 本题执行”阅读。Table 1 先固定方程，再分别读相对 L2 与 MSE；相对误差反映比例，均方误差还受数值尺度影响。
zh.caveat: 极低误差属于特定方程、边界条件与评价点，不能外推到任意 PDE。相似任务检索也依赖问题表示是否捕捉关键物理差异。可借鉴的是显式保存方法依赖、执行证据和适用范围，而不只存一段自然语言经验。

en.context: GRAFT-ATHENA represents numerical-method choice as structured decisions about representations, losses, optimizers and constraints. It aims to reuse experience from related problems rather than restart method search each time.
steps: Project problem and action dependency graphs into factored trees, where paths represent concrete combinations while preserving admissibility rules.
Encode a new problem as a fingerprint and retrieve similar solved cases to initialize method probabilities and expected observables.
Propose, implement and diagnose methods, extending the action vocabulary when needed and retaining both successful and failed runs.
evidence: Applications include physics-informed learning, inverse problems and numerical solvers, with Apollo-flow and blood-rheology cases alongside PDE benchmarks.

Table 1 reports relative L2 errors of 1.48×10⁻⁹ for Burgers and 6.20×10⁻¹⁰ for Helmholtz. Its Poisson MSE, 4.51×10⁻¹³, is above another agent's 3.95×10⁻¹³, so improvement is not uniform across every metric.
en.visual: Read Figure 1 through graph expansion, memory, problem encoding, warm-start and execution. In Table 1, hold the PDE fixed and separate relative L2 from MSE, which respond differently to scale.
en.caveat: Very low errors apply to specific equations, conditions and evaluation points. Transfer depends on representations preserving relevant physical differences. Explicit method dependencies and evidence-backed applicability are more informative than unstructured experience alone.

papers.title: AutoNumerics: An Autonomous, PDE-Agnostic Multi-Agent Pipeline for Scientific Computing
papers.name: AutoNumerics

zh.problem: 能否从偏微分方程描述自动构造可解释数值求解器？
zh.method: 多智能体提出经典数值方案，用由粗到细的残差验证筛选与改进实现。
zh.evaluation: 比较五个 CodePDE 标准问题及额外 PDE 测试；摘要与正文对测试规模的表述不一致，需按具体结果表核对。

en.problem: Can an interpretable numerical solver be constructed from a PDE description?
en.method: Agents propose classical numerical schemes and refine implementations through coarse-to-fine residual checks.
en.evaluation: Compares five CodePDE problems and additional PDE tests; the abstract and body report different suite counts, so check the specific result tables.

papers.sourceTitle: AutoNumerics: An Autonomous, PDE-Agnostic Multi-Agent Pipeline for Scientific Computing

zh: 求解器能运行只是第一步，还要检查误差、收敛和适用条件。
en: A runnable solver still needs checks on error, convergence and applicability.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先明确问题并选数值方案，再从粗到细运行。失败后重新开始，最后做数值验证与理论检查。
figures.en: Formulate the problem, choose a numerical scheme and execute from coarse to fine. Failed attempts restart; numerical and theoretical checks follow.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: nRMSE 是归一化误差，越低越好。比较同一 PDE 上的方法，再看跨问题的稳定性。
tables.en: Lower nRMSE is better. Compare methods on the same PDE before assessing consistency across problems.

zh.context: AutoNumerics 从自然语言 PDE 问题生成透明的经典数值求解器。它希望模型先选对离散与时间推进方法，再执行验证，而不是直接输出一个无法检查的解或一套任意代码。
steps: Formulator 提取方程、初边值条件和物理参数；Planner 提出有限差分、谱方法、有限体积及不同时间推进候选。
分析问题与方法特征，过滤不稳定或不物理的方案，再从粗网格开始执行和调试，逐步增加精度，减少一开始就运行昂贵错误程序。
用方程残差与结果误差检查输出，必要时重启实现，并给出理论分析与最终可执行求解代码。
evidence: Table 1 使用五个 CodePDE 标准问题：Advection、Burgers、Reaction–Diffusion、可压缩 Navier–Stokes 和 Darcy。除这些标准比较外，原文还讨论额外 PDE 测试；摘要与正文的规模表述不同，本页以具体结果表为准。
例如 Burgers 的 nRMSE 为 1.79×10⁻⁵，CodePDE 为 3.15×10⁻⁴；故意不合适的中心差分在 Advection 上出现 7.05×10¹² 的误差。这说明数值方法是否适合方程结构，比代码能否运行更关键。
zh.visual: Figure 1 前四步做问题表达与选方案，第五步粗到细执行，最后做验证。Table 1 的 nRMSE 越低越好；几何平均适合跨量级汇总，但缺项、不同训练资源和方程条件仍需逐项核对。
zh.caveat: 小残差不在所有情况下都能保证唯一、准确的物理解，边界条件与参考解质量同样重要。极低误差来自所测问题，不能自动推广。可借鉴的是先做数值稳定性筛选，再以便宜的粗计算检验方案。

en.context: AutoNumerics turns natural-language PDE descriptions into transparent classical numerical solvers. It selects discretization and time-stepping methods before execution and verification.
steps: Extract equations, initial/boundary conditions and parameters, then propose finite-difference, spectral, finite-volume and time-stepping options.
Filter unstable or nonphysical plans and execute coarse-to-fine, debugging cheaply before increasing resolution.
Check residuals and output errors, restart implementation when needed and return executable code with theoretical analysis.
evidence: Table 1 compares five CodePDE problems: advection, Burgers, reaction–diffusion, compressible Navier–Stokes and Darcy. Additional PDE testing is discussed, but abstract/body counts differ; this guide anchors comparisons to the explicit table.

Burgers nRMSE is 1.79×10⁻⁵ versus CodePDE's 3.15×10⁻⁴. An intentionally unsuitable central-difference scheme reaches 7.05×10¹² on advection, illustrating why numerical compatibility matters beyond execution.
en.visual: Figure 1 separates formulation/selection, coarse-to-fine execution and verification. In Table 1, lower nRMSE is better; geometric means summarize different orders of magnitude but do not remove missing data or differences in conditions and resources.
en.caveat: Small residuals do not universally guarantee a unique or physically correct solution. Boundary conditions and reference quality matter. Stability screening followed by inexpensive coarse tests is the reusable mechanism.

papers.title: Knowledge-driven autonomous materials research via collaborative multi-agent and robotic system (MARS)
papers.name: MARS

zh.problem: 材料知识、智能体决策和机器人实验如何形成闭环？
zh.method: 结合专门知识、协作智能体与实验工具，迭代提出合成方案并分析结果。
zh.evaluation: 以纳米晶与复合材料研究展示计算建议和机器人实验的结合。

en.problem: How can materials knowledge, agent decisions and robotic experiments form a closed loop?
en.method: Combines specialized knowledge, collaborating agents and experimental tools to iterate on synthesis proposals and results.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates the integration of computational proposals and robotic experiments in nanocrystal and composite-material research.

papers.sourceTitle: Knowledge-driven autonomous materials research via collaborative multi-agent and robotic system (MARS)

institutions: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 材料发现的闭环需要真实实验反馈，生成合理的合成计划只是其中一步。
en: Closed-loop materials discovery requires experimental feedback beyond a plausible synthesis plan.

zh.context: MARS 把材料知识检索、多 agent 决策与机器人实验接成一套流程。研究者用自然语言给出目标，系统需要把知识层面的设计建议转成机器人能执行的合成与分析操作。
steps: 协调器组织 19 个专业 agent，使用 16 种领域工具；科学组检索知识与设计方案，混合检索帮助连接不同领域的信息。
工程组把设计变成可执行协议，执行组控制机器人完成材料实验，将实际产物与测量结果交回系统。
分析组解释结果并提出下一轮优化策略，研究者可以查看过程、确认设计和下达实验指令，使知识与物理实验形成反馈。
evidence: 论文报告在十轮实验内优化钙钛矿纳米晶合成，使发光从绿色调向目标蓝色。它还设计了仿生多层保护结构的复合材料，并在初始查询后 3.5 小时得到相应水溶液样品。
这些是特定机器人平台与材料案例的实证。论文以常规研发时间作效率参照，但任务准备、既有设备、知识库和人工确认均需纳入理解，不能把该时间直接推广为所有材料研究的加速倍数。
zh.visual: 本页尚未收录可直接展示的原图。回看原文时，建议沿“设计提案 → 实验协议 → 实际合成 → 发光/稳定性表征”核对证据；设计得合理、样品制成和性质改善，是三个需要分别支持的结论。
zh.caveat: 材料体系和自动化设备限定了当前适用范围，系统不是凭自然语言就能操作任何实验室。可借鉴的是在知识推理与机器人执行之间设置明确协议，并让实测数据影响下一轮设计。

en.context: MARS connects materials knowledge, multi-agent decisions and robotic experiments. Natural-language research goals must become concrete synthesis and analysis protocols.
steps: An orchestrator coordinates 19 specialized agents and 16 tools, with scientific agents retrieving knowledge and developing designs.
Engineering agents convert designs into executable protocols; execution agents operate robots and return measurements.
Analysis agents interpret outcomes and suggest refinements, with researchers able to inspect progress and authorize experimental directions.
evidence: The paper reports perovskite synthesis optimization within ten iterations and a biomimetic protective composite produced as an aqueous sample within 3.5 hours of the initial query.

These are specific platform/material demonstrations. Timing comparisons depend on existing equipment, curated knowledge, preparation and human confirmation rather than establishing a universal materials-research speedup.
en.visual: No source figure is displayed yet. In the original, trace proposal → protocol → synthesized sample → optical/stability measurements. Plausible design, successful fabrication and improved properties require distinct evidence.
en.caveat: The demonstrated materials and robotic interfaces bound applicability. The reusable idea is an explicit protocol layer linking knowledge-based design to execution, with measured outcomes feeding subsequent decisions.

papers.title: CASCADE: Cumulative Agentic Skill Creation through Autonomous Development and Evolution
papers.name: CASCADE

zh.problem: 智能体能否把做过的科学任务变成可再次执行的技能？
zh.method: 通过网页、代码和执行反馈获取能力，用记忆与自省机制保存并改进技能。
zh.evaluation: SciSkillBench 包含 116 项材料与化学任务，涉及计算、实验和论文复现。

en.problem: Can completed scientific tasks become reusable executable skills?
en.method: Acquires capabilities from web resources, code and execution feedback, retaining and refining skills through memory and introspection.
en.evaluation: SciSkillBench includes 116 materials and chemistry tasks spanning computation, experiments and paper reproduction.

papers.sourceTitle: CASCADE: Cumulative Agentic Skill Creation through Autonomous Development and Evolution

zh: 工具获取与持续积累扩展了代理的能力，但新技能仍需通过具体任务检验。
en: Skill acquisition expands capability, but new skills still require task-level validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 比较左侧依赖现成工具与右侧自己获取技能的路径。新工具经过学习和执行后，被保留下来服务后续任务。
figures.en: Compare reliance on existing tools with acquiring new skills. Tools learned through execution are retained for later tasks.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 看不同领域的任务通过率，并保持基础模型和尝试次数一致。技能学习的收益需要在后续任务中体现。
tables.en: Compare task pass rates with matched backbones and attempt counts, looking for benefits on later tasks.

zh.context: CASCADE 希望 agent 遇到陌生科学软件时，不只停在“没有这个工具”，而能查文档、读代码、尝试执行，再把学会的方法变成下次可复用的技能。它把一次工具调用扩展成能力获取过程。
steps: 协调器先检索已有记忆，根据任务难度选择 SimpleSolver 或 DeepSolver，能复用现成方案时不必重新展开完整探索。
复杂任务中，Solution Researcher 查资料和写初始方案，Code Agent 执行，Debug Agents 根据报错与运行时检查修正，Output Processor 整理最终结果。
把可运行方案和经验整理到持久记忆，通过向量与图结构检索，在后续任务中继续使用和修订。
evidence: SciSkillBench 包含 116 个材料与化学任务。Table 1 中 GPT-5 的 Native 成功率 35.36%，Search&Debug 为 89.74%，DeepSolver 为 93.26%；大部分增益已来自搜索与调试，完整系统再提供额外改善。
代价也增加：相应平均时间为 240、504、588 秒。表中的 Success Rate 与 Pass@1/2/3 使用不同汇总方式，增加允许尝试次数自然可能增加至少成功一次的机会，比较时要固定口径。
zh.visual: Figure 1b 先看简单/复杂路径选择，1c 再看复杂路径中的执行与调试。Table 1 在同一模型、同一指标和题目难度下比较，最后结合耗时判断多出的成功率用了多少额外资源。
zh.caveat: 保存技能并不保证它在新的软件版本或任务前提下仍有效。论文也展示实验室与论文复现案例，但不能由 116 个任务概括任意科学工具。可借鉴的是将执行验证后的代码、依赖与经验一起保留，而非只保存一段答案。

en.context: CASCADE aims to acquire scientific capabilities when a needed tool is unfamiliar: read documentation and code, execute it, then retain the working procedure as a reusable skill.
steps: Retrieve memory and route tasks to SimpleSolver or DeepSolver, reusing prior solutions when possible.
For complex tasks, research a solution, execute code, debug using runtime evidence and process the resulting outputs through specialized agents.
Consolidate working procedures and experience in persistent vector/graph memory for later retrieval and revision.
evidence: SciSkillBench contains 116 materials and chemistry tasks. For GPT-5 in Table 1, success rates rise from 35.36% Native to 89.74% Search&Debug and 93.26% DeepSolver; search and debugging already explain much of the gain.
Average times are 240, 504 and 588 seconds. Success Rate and Pass@1/2/3 use different aggregations, and more allowed attempts increase opportunities for at least one success.
en.visual: Figure 1b shows routing and 1c details the complex execution/debug loop. Compare Table 1 under the same model, metric and difficulty before relating additional success to extra time.
en.caveat: Stored skills can become invalid under changed software or task assumptions. Laboratory and reproduction cases do not establish universal tool competence. Retaining verified code, dependencies and applicability is more useful than saving only an answer.

papers.title: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Materials Computation
papers.name: VASP Agent

zh.problem: 第一性原理计算如何更可靠地从自然语言走到实际执行？
zh.method: 结合领域技能、确定性工具和工作空间状态，根据运行证据检查并恢复工作流。
zh.evaluation: 案例包括结构弛豫、能带、晶格常数与表面吸附计算。

en.problem: How can natural-language requests reliably become first-principles calculations?
en.method: Combines domain skills, deterministic tools and workspace state, using runtime evidence to check and recover workflows.
en.evaluation: Cases include structural relaxation, electronic bands, lattice constants and surface adsorption calculations.

papers.sourceTitle: VASP Agent: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous First-principles Calculations

institutions: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh: 这类代理的价值在可靠完成计算工作流；物理结果还取决于计算设置是否正确。
en: Workflow automation helps complete calculations; physical validity also depends on the chosen computational settings.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理协调工作区、材料技能与计算资源。输入设置结合文献和规范，执行后检查结果，并根据报错恢复计算。
figures.en: The agent coordinates workspaces, materials skills and compute resources. Evidence guides input preparation, followed by result checks and error recovery.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 能量偏差使用 meV/atom，越低越接近参考；同时看结构弛豫任务有没有完成。
tables.en: Energy deviation is in meV/atom; lower is closer to the reference. Also check relaxation-task completion.

zh.context: VASP Agent 面向第一性原理材料计算：结构、参数文件、赝势和长作业状态必须彼此一致。一次运行结束并不够，还要知道输入是否合适、结果能否解释，以及中途失败怎样恢复。
steps: coding agent 检查持久工作区和任务状态，调用材料技能、文档证据与确定性工具准备 VASP 输入，并说明关键参数的选择依据。
提交本地或 HPC 计算，读取日志与中间输出；遇到固定流水线难以处理的错误时，更新计划并修正相关状态。
检查最终输出与任务要求，将经过验证的特殊情况处理整理成可复用技能，而不是只把整个会话原样保存。
evidence: 案例包括结构弛豫、带隙、平衡晶格常数和 CO/Pt(111) 吸附。Table 2 的结构弛豫中，DeepSeek-V3.2 版 VASP Agent 完成 40/40，固定 workflow 基线为 36/40。
完成更多不表示每个数值更接近参考：agent 的平均能量偏差为 62.42 meV/atom，基线为 80.36；但中位偏差为 5.65，基线为 2.20。均值和中位数呈现不同情况，且参考输入设置本身也需要科学判断。
zh.visual: Figure 1b 看参数准备的证据来源与试探计算，1c 看经验如何进入技能。Table 2 先读 Completion，再分别看能量/结构偏差的均值与中位数；少数大偏差可能显著影响均值。
zh.caveat: parseable 输出是完成定义，不能独自保证物理正确。不同泛函、赝势和收敛条件会改变数值，参考结果也不是绝对真值。可借鉴的是让关键输入有依据，并把运行证据和多步状态管理纳入 agent 控制。

en.context: VASP Agent handles first-principles calculations whose structures, parameter files, potentials and long-running jobs must remain consistent. Completion also requires checking inputs, interpreting results and recovering from failures.
steps: Inspect workspace state and use domain skills, documentation and deterministic tools to prepare justified VASP inputs.
Run local or HPC calculations, inspect logs and intermediate outputs, and revise plans when execution fails.
Validate outputs against the task and encode verified special-case handling as reusable skills.
evidence: Cases cover relaxation, band gaps, lattice constants and CO/Pt(111) adsorption. In Table 2, the DeepSeek-V3.2 agent completes 40/40 relaxation cases versus 36/40 for the workflow baseline.

Its mean energy deviation is 62.42 meV/atom versus 80.36, but median deviation is 5.65 versus 2.20. More completion does not imply uniformly closer numerical agreement; means, medians and parameter choices matter.
en.visual: Figure 1b shows evidence used to choose inputs and c shows skill accumulation. Read Table 2's completion before mean/median energy and structural deviations; outliers can dominate means.
en.caveat: Parseable output is not proof of physical correctness. Functionals, potentials and convergence settings affect results, and references are not absolute truth. Evidence-backed inputs and state-aware recovery are the central reusable mechanisms.

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Functional Materials Discovery
papers.name: MASTER

zh.problem: 如何减少材料筛选中昂贵的第一性原理计算？
zh.method: 多智能体设计并解释计算，通过分层同行评议与主动学习优先选择候选。
zh.evaluation: 在催化材料的 CO 吸附研究中评估筛选效率和样本使用。

en.problem: How can expensive first-principles calculations be reduced in materials screening?
en.method: Agents design and interpret calculations, using hierarchical peer review and active learning to prioritize candidates.
en.evaluation: Evaluates screening efficiency and sample use in catalyst studies involving CO adsorption.

papers.sourceTitle: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Functional Materials Discovery

zh: 主动学习把候选生成与第一性原理计算连接起来，验证范围仍是所研究的材料与性质。
en: Active learning links candidate generation to first-principles calculations within the studied materials and properties.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 设计代理提出材料，模拟代理构造并计算结构，评审代理依据目标筛选。关注计算得到的吸附能如何影响下一轮候选。
figures.en: Design agents propose materials, simulation agents calculate structures, and a reviewer checks objectives. Follow how calculated adsorption energies guide later candidates.

zh.context: MASTER 研究的是如何少做昂贵 DFT 计算就找到目标材料。它让 LLM 根据已有模拟结果决定下一个候选，而不只是把人指定的计算流程自动跑完。
steps: 设计层根据目标吸附能和过去结果提出材料候选，可使用单 agent、同行评议或不同分诊排序策略讨论下一次计算。
模拟层把高层目标转成原子结构与 DFT 工作流，执行所选候选的计算，返回吸附能等可比较性质。
评审层判断是否落在目标区间；若未达到，就把结果加入历史，再指导下一轮候选选择，构成主动学习。
evidence: 两个应用分别是 Cu 表面过渡金属原子与 M–N–C 催化剂上的 CO 吸附。相对试错选择，论文报告最高可减少 90% 的原子模拟次数；这是特定目标和比较条件下的最大减少量。
作者还分析推理强度：弱吸附目标下，平均迭代由约 3.5 降到 2.6。每轮需要有 CO 与无 CO 的两次 DFT 计算，因此少一轮具有实际计算意义，但仍要考虑额外 LLM 推理成本。
zh.visual: Figure 1a 看设计、模拟与评审如何传递候选和能量；1b/1c 的阴影带是目标吸附区间。这里要找的是落进目标窗口的材料，吸附能并非越负越好；过强或过弱都可能不满足目标。
zh.caveat: 结果来自两类指定催化体系，不能直接推广到任意材料空间。推理轨迹中的化学术语也不是机制正确性的充分证据。可借鉴的是让领域推理服务于昂贵实验的选择，并按达到目标需要多少次真实计算评价效率。

en.context: MASTER tries to find target materials with fewer expensive DFT calculations. LLMs choose the next candidate using simulation history rather than merely executing a human-selected workflow.
steps: Design agents propose materials for a target adsorption-energy range using single-agent, peer-review or triage strategies.
Simulation agents construct atomic geometries and DFT workflows, execute calculations and return measurable properties.
A reviewer checks whether the target is met; otherwise the result informs another candidate-selection round.
evidence: Applications cover CO adsorption on transition-metal adatoms on Cu and on M–N–C catalysts. The reported reduction of up to 90% in simulations is a best-case result under specific target/comparator conditions.

For a weak-binding target, higher reasoning effort reduces average iterations from about 3.5 to 2.6. Each iteration requires calculations with and without adsorbed CO, though extra LLM inference also has a cost.
en.visual: Figure 1a links design, simulation and review; shaded bands in b/c are desired adsorption-energy windows. More negative is not automatically better: either excessively strong or weak binding can miss the target.
en.caveat: Two catalyst families do not establish universal materials-search performance. Chemically phrased reasoning is not itself a mechanism validation. The useful principle is to direct expensive evaluations with accumulated evidence and measure actual calculations needed to reach a target.

papers.title: SciToolAgent: A knowledge-graph-driven scientific agent for multitool integration
papers.name: SciToolAgent

zh.problem: 大量科学工具怎样被组织成可执行的研究流程？
zh.method: 使用知识图谱检索、选择和编排工具，并对工具调用进行检查。
zh.evaluation: 展示生物、化学与材料任务，包括蛋白质、反应和材料设计案例。

en.problem: How can many scientific tools be organized into an executable workflow?
en.method: Uses a knowledge graph to retrieve, select and orchestrate tools, with checks on tool execution.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates biology, chemistry and materials tasks, including protein, reaction and materials-design cases.

papers.sourceTitle: SciToolAgent: A knowledge-graph-driven scientific agent for multitool integration

institutions: State Key Laboratory of Ocean Sensing

zh: 大量工具只有被正确选择和组合，才能转化为可完成的科学任务。
en: A large tool library becomes useful only when tools are selected and combined correctly.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 从科学问题出发，规划需要的工具链并执行。读图时把检索工具、工具之间的依赖和实际执行结果分开看。
figures.en: Start from the scientific question and trace the planned tool chain. Distinguish tool retrieval, dependencies and actual execution outcomes.

zh.context: SciToolAgent 面对的问题是科学工具之间有依赖和兼容关系：知道哪个工具名称相关，还不够完成一个多步骤任务。它用 SciToolKG 保存工具关系，帮助规划能够实际连接起来的工作流。
steps: Planner 根据研究问题检索工具图，考虑工具用途、前提和输入输出兼容性，生成有顺序的工具链。
Executor 按计划准备参数并依次运行工具，处理失败与重试，避免只输出一份未执行的建议清单。
Summarizer 汇总各工具结果，形成最终答案并评估过程。工具执行还经过专门检查模块，系统实现与接口见官方项目。
evidence: 论文展示蛋白工程、反应性预测、化学合成和 MOF 筛选案例，说明其工具组织跨越多个学科。官方项目说明集成 500 多种工具，包含 API、模型、Python 函数和数据库。
项目的评价接口分别检查最终答案与 tool path。两者分开很有用：一条看似合理的路径可能因参数或返回值错误而失败，而工具数量本身也不能代表任务完成质量。
zh.visual: Fig. 1 适合沿问题、图检索、计划、执行和汇总追踪。关注前一个工具的输出怎样变成后一个工具的输入，以及图中的依赖关系怎样约束排序；这比把图理解成“大模型外接很多工具”更准确。
zh.caveat: 图谱需要维护工具定义与兼容条件，外部 API 和科学软件变化后原计划可能失效。跨领域案例不等于一个工具链适用于全部领域。可借鉴的是显式表达工具间关系，并将计划质量与执行结果分别评价。

en.context: SciToolAgent addresses dependencies between scientific tools: retrieving a relevant tool name is not enough to complete a multi-step workflow. SciToolKG records relationships needed for useful composition.
steps: A planner retrieves tool-graph information about functions, prerequisites and compatibility to construct an ordered tool chain.
An executor prepares arguments and runs tools sequentially with failure handling and retries.
A summarizer combines outputs into an answer and assesses the process, alongside execution checks described in the official project.
evidence: Paper cases include protein engineering, reaction prediction, chemical synthesis and MOF screening. The official project describes over 500 APIs, models, functions and databases.
Its evaluation interfaces separately assess final answers and tool paths. A sensible plan can still fail through incorrect parameters or outputs, so collection size is not a success metric.
en.visual: Follow Fig. 1 from question and graph retrieval to planning, execution and synthesis. Inspect how one output becomes the next input and how dependencies constrain order.
en.caveat: Tool definitions and compatibility need maintenance as software and APIs change. Cross-domain examples do not make every chain universally applicable. Explicit tool relationships and separate planning/execution evaluation are the reusable ideas.

papers.title: CheMatAgent: Enhancing LLMs for Chemistry and Materials Science through Tree-Search Based Tool Learning
papers.name: CheMatAgent

zh.problem: 模型如何学会选择化学工具并正确填写参数？
zh.method: 整合 137 个工具，用分层树搜索生成学习轨迹，并分别优化规划与执行。
zh.evaluation: 构建 ChemToolBench，并在化学问答与发现任务中评估训练后的策略。

en.problem: How can a model learn to select chemistry tools and supply correct arguments?
en.method: Integrates 137 tools and uses hierarchical tree search to generate learning trajectories and optimize planning and execution separately.
en.evaluation: Introduces ChemToolBench and evaluates trained policies on chemistry question answering and discovery tasks.

papers.sourceTitle: CheMatAgent: Enhancing LLMs for Chemistry and Materials Science through Tree-Search Based Tool Learning

zh: 面向领域的工具训练，需要用单次调用和多步骤调用分别检验。
en: Domain-specific tool training should be evaluated on both individual calls and multi-step workflows.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 图中把化学工具接入代理推理流程。再结合工具调用数据构建过程，看模型学到的是哪些实际操作。
figures.en: The diagram connects chemistry tools to agent reasoning. Read it alongside the training-data pipeline to identify which operations the model learns.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 这里检验连续调用多个化学工具；单次调用正确并不保证整条任务链正确。
tables.en: This tests multi-tool chemistry workflows; a correct individual call does not guarantee a correct workflow.

zh.context: CheMatAgent 不只教模型“该调用哪个化学工具”，还教它把参数填对并读懂返回结果。工具选择、参数执行和整条任务成功，是三个可能分别失败的环节。
steps: 整理 137 个化学工具，构建 ChemToolBench，让任务覆盖检索、化学信息处理和复杂预测，并提供工具调用层面的训练与评价材料。
用分层演化蒙特卡洛树搜索分别优化规划与执行，让系统探索不同工具选择和具体调用，而不是把全部决策压成一次输出。
利用自生成轨迹做步骤级微调，并训练过程奖励与结果奖励模型，再把工具返回值用于生成最终回答。
evidence: Table 2 分别报告格式、工具、参数、返回值和整项 Pass Rate。基础 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 Pass Rate 为 15.00，带星号的训练版本为 55.00，HE-MCTS 的 M2 配置为 72.30；这些配置包含不同训练与搜索因素。
即使某一列工具 F1 超过 90，也不意味着整条研究流程九成成功。串联调用会放大早期错误，表中最终通过率明显低于多个局部指标，显示为什么必须评价端到端执行。
zh.visual: Figure 1 先区分工具资源、数据生成和训练/搜索环节。Table 2 固定配置后从 Format 一直读到 Pass Rate；P/R/F1 是局部调用匹配指标，最后一列才回答整项工作是否通过。
zh.caveat: 树搜索增加计算成本，训练数据和奖励模型也会影响结果，不能把所有增益归为“多 agent”。可借鉴的是分开优化工具计划与参数执行，并使用真实返回值核对整条流程。

en.context: CheMatAgent learns tool choice, correct arguments and interpretation of results. Each can fail independently, so local tool-call accuracy must be distinguished from complete workflow success.
steps: Assemble 137 chemistry tools and curate ChemToolBench for training and evaluating tool selection and parameter filling.
Use hierarchical evolutionary Monte Carlo tree search to optimize planning and execution separately.
Fine-tune on self-generated step trajectories and train process/outcome reward models, then synthesize answers from actual tool returns.
evidence: Table 2 separates format, tool, parameter, return and Pass Rate. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct rises from 15.00 pass rate to 55.00 for the starred trained variant and 72.30 for M2, with training and search configurations changing together.
Tool F1 above 90 does not imply a 90% workflow success rate. Sequential calls propagate earlier errors, explaining the gap between local metrics and final passes.
en.visual: Figure 1 separates tools, data generation and training/search. In Table 2, follow one configuration from Format to Pass Rate; P/R/F1 concern local matching, while the final column assesses the whole task.
en.caveat: Search adds computational overhead and results depend on training data and reward models. The reusable pattern is separate optimization of plans and concrete calls, followed by end-to-end checks against actual outputs.

papers.title: MOFGen: System of Agentic AI for the Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks
papers.name: MOFGen

zh.problem: 生成的金属有机框架能否同时具有目标性质和可合成性？
zh.method: 组合成分提案、扩散结构生成、量子计算筛选与合成可行性智能体。
zh.evaluation: 通过高通量实验检验，并报告成功合成五种设计的 MOF。

en.problem: Can generated metal-organic frameworks have target properties and be synthesizable?
en.method: Combines composition proposals, diffusion-based structure generation, quantum screening and synthesis-feasibility agents.
en.evaluation: Validated through high-throughput experiments, with five designed MOFs reported as synthesized.

papers.sourceTitle: System of Agentic AI for the Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks

institutions: Bakar Institute of Digital Materials for the Planet

zh: 多种模型各自处理擅长的环节；生成的结构仍要通过稳定性与可合成性检查。
en: Specialized models handle different stages; generated structures still need stability and synthesizability checks.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 语言代理提出连接体组成，扩散模型生成晶体结构，后续工具评估并筛选。分清结构生成、计算筛选与合成验证三个环节。
figures.en: A language agent proposes linker compositions, a diffusion model generates crystal structures, and tools evaluate candidates. Distinguish generation, computational screening and synthesis validation.

zh.context: MOFGen 试图跨过生成材料中的实际难点：计算机能画出一个漂亮晶体，并不代表它有孔、稳定、配体可制备，或能在实验中合成。它把组成生成、结构生成、计算筛选和合成接在一起。
steps: MOFMaster 接收组成或金属节点等约束，LinkerGen 提出化学组成，再由按组成条件化的扩散模型 CrystalGen 生成原子级晶体结构。
QForge 做结构优化与孔隙筛选，SynthABLE 拆出构筑单元、用规则和模型检查合成可行性；QHarden 再做更高精度量子计算和形成能评价。
SynthGen 结合合成规划与高通量机器人筛选条件，实际制备后用单晶或粉末 X 射线衍射检查结构，并把实验结构加入资料池。
evidence: 论文生成了大量候选，并从 349 个高置信配体的起始集合开展实验验证，最终报告五个 AI-MOF 合成案例。五个是实验证实的材料数量，不是全部生成候选都获得了验证。
实验路线包括已有配体与新金属节点组合、专家对灵感配体做微调，以及直接尝试新设计配体。它体现多种人机协作路径，因此不应把每个案例都理解为未经任何人工修正的直接生成到合成。
zh.visual: Figure 1 的七个模块按筛选顺序读，每经过一层都问排除了哪类失败。尤其区分 SynthABLE 的预测可合成与 SynthGen 的实际制备，再看衍射表征是否支持生成结构与拓扑。
zh.caveat: 筛选会缩小候选空间，但预测的稳定性、可合成性和最终应用性能仍是不同问题。可借鉴的是由便宜到昂贵逐层验证，并清楚标记模型生成、专家修改与实验证实之间的关系。

en.context: MOFGen addresses the gap between generating a crystal and obtaining a porous, stable, synthesizable material. It connects composition and structure generation with computational screening and physical synthesis.
steps: MOFMaster accepts constraints, LinkerGen proposes compositions and a composition-conditioned diffusion model generates atomic crystal structures.
Optimize and screen porosity, assess building-block synthesizability through rules and models, then apply higher-level quantum calculations and formation-energy checks.
Use synthesis planning and a high-throughput robotic platform, verify structures with X-ray diffraction and retain experimental structures.
evidence: Experimental validation begins from 349 high-confidence linkers and reports five synthesized AI-MOF cases. That count does not validate the entire generated candidate pool.

Routes include recombining known linkers with metal nodes, expert modifications inspired by generated linkers and direct synthesis of new designs. These represent different degrees of human intervention.
en.visual: Read Figure 1's seven modules as successive filters. Distinguish SynthABLE's predicted synthesizability from SynthGen's actual synthesis, then inspect whether diffraction supports the proposed structure and topology.
en.caveat: Predicted stability, synthetic feasibility and application performance remain separate questions. The reusable approach is progressively more expensive validation with explicit provenance for generated, human-modified and experimentally confirmed designs.

papers.title: PriM: Principle-Inspired Material Discovery through Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.name: PriM

zh.problem: 材料发现能否利用科学原理，同时解释探索决策？
zh.method: 让多个智能体进行圆桌式讨论，将原理引导的假设生成与实验验证连接。
zh.evaluation: 以纳米螺旋材料为案例，比较探索效率与目标性质。

en.problem: Can materials discovery use scientific principles while explaining exploration decisions?
en.method: Uses roundtable-style agent discussion to connect principle-guided hypothesis generation with experimental validation.
en.evaluation: Uses nanohelix materials as a case study, comparing exploration efficiency and target properties.

papers.sourceTitle: PriM: Principle-Inspired Material Discovery through Multi-Agent Collaboration

zh: 保存“为什么这样改”的原则，有助于把实验结果转化为后续可用的经验。
en: Retaining the rationale for changes turns experimental results into reusable research experience.

figures.label: Figure 4
figures.zh: 沿步骤比较研究原则、参数调整和目标指标怎样一起变化。它展示了每次实验如何影响下一次假设。
figures.en: Compare changes in scientific principles, parameters and the target metric across steps. The sequence shows how experiments inform later hypotheses.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 表中均值与标准差应一起看，判断策略是否稳定地改善目标性质。
tables.en: Read means together with standard deviations when judging consistent improvement in the target property.

zh.context: PriM 希望材料搜索不只报出下一组参数，还能说明根据什么科学原则做这个选择。它用多 agent 圆桌式讨论，把文献线索、假设和测试反馈串成有解释的搜索过程。
steps: Literature Agent 整理已有知识，Hypothesis Agent 据此提出可以测试的结构—性质关系；中央 Planner 组织讨论和检查任务约束。
围绕纳米螺旋的结构参数提出候选，用 Virtual Lab 给出 g-factor 性质预测，再讨论结果怎样支持或改变当前原则。
保存每轮原则、参数变化和结果，继续权衡探索新区域与细化已有好区域，目标是找到手性较强的结构。
evidence: 实验使用训练模型构建的虚拟实验室，并进行五次随机初始化运行；训练数据来自合作项目，论文说明当时未公开。因此这里的实验反馈是代理模型预测，并非每一步都进行了湿实验。
Table 1 中 PriM 最佳性质均值 1.007，高于 Vanilla MAS 的 0.923，但低于 BO 的 1.081；迭代数为 85.50，也高于 Vanilla MAS 的 65.40。贡献更多在原则化推理和搜索路径，不能概括为所有数值都最优。
zh.visual: Figure 4 把每次原则变化与参数、g-factor 对齐，可以检查解释是否随新证据改变。Table 1 的 exploration rate 是实验条件间平均成对距离，不是成功率；它表示探索跨度，不能简单理解为越高越好。
zh.caveat: 语言解释是否符合真实机制仍需要外部验证，代理模型也可能有偏差。可借鉴的是保存选择依据与结果的对应关系，让人能检查为什么改变方向，同时用真实实验进一步验证候选。

en.context: PriM aims to explain why a materials-search system chooses its next parameters. Roundtable agents connect literature-derived principles, hypotheses and testing feedback into an interpretable search history.
steps: Literature and hypothesis agents develop testable structure–property ideas, coordinated by a planner.
Propose nanohelix structural parameters and obtain g-factor predictions from a Virtual Lab, then revise the guiding principles using the outcomes.
Record principles, parameter changes and results while balancing exploration with refinement of promising regions.
evidence: Five runs use a learned virtual laboratory; its collaboration-derived training data were not public. Feedback is therefore surrogate prediction, not a new wet experiment at every step.

Table 1 gives PriM a mean optimal property of 1.007, above Vanilla MAS's 0.923 but below BO's 1.081. It also uses 85.50 iterations versus 65.40 for Vanilla MAS, so not every numerical criterion improves.
en.visual: Figure 4 aligns changing principles with parameters and g-factors. Table 1's exploration rate is average pairwise distance between experimental conditions, not success rate or an automatically higher-is-better metric.
en.caveat: Plausible explanations and surrogate predictions still need external validation. Recording the rationale alongside actual outcomes makes search inspectable, while physical experiments remain necessary to validate candidate mechanisms and properties.

papers.title: SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery Through Bioinspired Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning
papers.name: SciAgents

zh.problem: 跨文献的知识连接能否产生新的仿生材料研究思路？
zh.method: 把科学知识组织为图谱，利用不同角色的智能体推理、提出和修订假设。
zh.evaluation: 展示材料研究假设与推理过程；假设生成本身不等于完成湿实验验证。

en.problem: Can connections across the literature generate new bioinspired-materials ideas?
en.method: Organizes scientific knowledge as a graph and uses role-specialized agents to reason about, propose and refine hypotheses.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates materials hypotheses and reasoning; generating a hypothesis does not itself establish wet-lab validation.

papers.sourceTitle: SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery Through Bioinspired Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning

zh: 知识图适合跨领域寻找假设线索；假设的可行性仍需要后续验证。
en: Knowledge graphs support cross-domain hypothesis discovery, followed by feasibility validation.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 知识图把跨文献概念连起来，多个角色围绕这些联系提出并批评材料假设。图中的推理链提供了追溯想法来源的线索。
figures.en: A knowledge graph connects concepts across papers; specialized roles propose and critique materials hypotheses. The reasoning chain helps trace where ideas originate.

zh.context: SciAgents 用文献知识图寻找生物启发材料中的跨领域连接。它希望让不同角色围绕一条知识路径提出并批评新研究方向，使假设比一次普通问答更有结构和细节。
steps: 先把论文中的概念与关系组织成图，再通过节点表示、路径搜索和随机中间点抽取连接不同概念的路径，作为讨论上下文。
Ontologist 澄清概念与关系，Scientist 1 起草研究方案，Scientist 2 扩展，Critic 审核并提出修改，逐步补充机制、设计原则和预期性质。
比较预设顺序的角色交互与动态规划的多 agent 形式；后者还由 Planner 安排讨论，并检查候选假设的新颖性。
evidence: 使用的知识图来自约一千篇论文，包含 33,159 个节点、48,753 条边。图规模描述可检索知识结构，而不是已发现或已验证的材料数量。
论文主要通过材料研究假设与推理案例展示系统如何组合概念、补充方案和批评想法。这里需要区分“有详细机制叙述”与“该机制已通过实验成立”；所展示流程本身不能提供后一种保证。
zh.visual: Figure 1a 展示从论文到知识图，1b/1c 对比固定顺序与动态交互。读一条路径时逐个检查边的关系类型：文献中的关联可以启发假设，但沿多条关联拼出的因果链仍需要额外证据。
zh.caveat: 知识抽取错误与模型共同偏好可能在讨论中被重复强化。可借鉴的是用明确概念路径约束跨领域构想，再把假设、反驳和待验证条件并列保存，帮助研究者选择下一步实验。

en.context: SciAgents uses literature knowledge graphs to propose cross-disciplinary ideas for bioinspired materials. Specialized agents develop and critique hypotheses around selected graph paths.
steps: Build a concept-relation graph and sample connecting paths using embeddings, path search and randomized waypoints.
An ontologist clarifies concepts, two scientist roles develop the proposal, and a critic identifies weaknesses and refinements.
Compare fixed interaction sequences with a dynamically planned multi-agent workflow that also checks proposed novelty.
evidence: The graph draws on roughly one thousand papers and contains 33,159 nodes and 48,753 edges. These are knowledge-structure counts, not validated materials discoveries.
Case studies demonstrate detailed proposals, mechanisms and critique. A detailed mechanism narrative is still distinct from experimental evidence that the mechanism operates.
en.visual: Figure 1a builds the graph, while b/c compare fixed and dynamic interactions. Inspect relation types along a path: linked literature associations can inspire a hypothesis without establishing a causal chain.
en.caveat: Extraction errors and shared model preferences can be reinforced through discussion. Explicit concept paths, criticisms and unresolved validation conditions help researchers decide which generated ideas deserve experiments.

papers.title: A Review of Large Language Models and Autonomous Agents in Chemistry
papers.name: LLMs & Autonomous Agents in Chemistry

zh.problem: 大模型和工具型智能体在化学中有哪些能力与缺口？
zh.method: 梳理分子设计、性质预测、合成规划和实验自动化，并讨论数据与可解释性问题。
zh.evaluation: 综述论文，提出评测与跨工具整合的研究需求。

en.problem: What can language models and tool-using agents do in chemistry, and what remains missing?
en.method: Reviews molecular design, property prediction, synthesis planning and experimental automation, including data and interpretability issues.
en.evaluation: A review identifying research needs in evaluation and integration across tools.

papers.sourceTitle: A Review of Large Language Models and Autonomous Agents in Chemistry

zh: 模型能力与代理工作流是两个层面，读综述时应分别比较。
en: Compare model capabilities and agent workflows as separate layers.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 这张总览连接性质预测、分子生成与合成预测。代理位于模型和工具之间，负责把单项能力组织成任务。
figures.en: The overview connects property prediction, molecular generation and synthesis prediction. Agents organize these specialized models and tools into workflows.

zh.context: 这篇化学综述将两类进展放在一起：语言模型自身学到的化学能力，以及通过调用外部工具形成的自主 agent。它覆盖分子设计、性质预测、合成规划和自动实验，帮助定位每种方法究竟改变了哪一步。
steps: 先梳理语言模型如何表示和处理化学信息，以及它们在预测性质、按目标生成分子和预测合成方面的作用。
再看 agent 怎样连接论文检索、专门模型、数据库和自动实验平台，把多个单点能力组成任务流程。
最后对照数据质量、可解释性、工具集成和评测标准，指出跨方法比较中哪些证据仍然缺少，并讨论多模态与实验协作方向。
evidence: 这是综述文章，证据来自所引用研究的综合，没有训练一个统一系统后给出总成功率。文中为 agent 部分适当扩展到化学之外，以借鉴其他科学领域的工作流设计。
例如性质预测回答候选可能具有什么性质，目标导向生成提出新的候选，合成预测讨论能怎样制备；三者可以连接，但其中任一步表现较好，不能单独证明最终分子能合成且有效。
zh.visual: Figure 1 将性质预测、按性质生成和合成预测并列，再用 agent 连接这些模型与工具。阅读时可以给每个模块标出输入、输出和验证来源，明确哪些是模型预测、哪些有实验观测。
zh.caveat: 综述发表于快速发展的阶段，所整理方法的版本、数据和预算各不相同。可借鉴的是先拆清科学问题与各模块责任，再选择适当 benchmark；不能只用自然语言表现或工具数量评价化学研究能力。

en.context: This chemistry review connects capabilities learned inside language models with agents that use external tools. It covers molecular design, property prediction, synthesis planning and experimental automation.
steps: Review chemical representations and model roles in property prediction, goal-directed generation and synthesis prediction.
Examine how agents connect literature, specialized models, databases and laboratory platforms into workflows.
Compare data quality, interpretability, integration and evaluation needs, including multimodal and experimental directions.
evidence: This is a synthesis of prior studies, not one system with a unified success rate. The agent discussion also includes other sciences to draw workflow lessons.
Predicting a property, proposing a candidate and planning synthesis answer different questions. Success in one component does not establish that the final molecule is synthesizable and useful.
en.visual: Figure 1 places prediction, generation and synthesis modules side by side and connects them through agents. Label each module's inputs, outputs and evidence source to distinguish model predictions from measured outcomes.
en.caveat: Reviewed systems differ in versions, data and budgets. The useful framework assigns clear scientific responsibilities to modules and chooses relevant benchmarks; fluent language or tool counts alone do not measure chemical research competence.

papers.title: LLMatDesign: Autonomous Materials Discovery with Large Language Models
papers.name: LLMatDesign

zh.problem: 在数据有限时，如何按用户目标修改材料？
zh.method: 用语言模型解释指令、提出材料修改、调用工具评价，并反思此前决策。
zh.evaluation: 在多个计算材料设计任务中测试；验证范围主要是计算模拟。

en.problem: How can materials be modified toward user goals with limited data?
en.method: A language model interprets instructions, proposes material modifications, evaluates them with tools and reflects on earlier decisions.
en.evaluation: Tested on several computational materials-design tasks; validation is primarily in silico.

papers.sourceTitle: LLMatDesign: Autonomous Materials Discovery with Large Language Models

zh: 自然语言指导材料搜索的效果，取决于性质预测工具和反馈是否可靠。
en: Language-guided materials search depends on reliable property predictions and feedback.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 从初始组成和目标性质开始，代理提出增删替换等修改，工具预测结构与性质，反思模块再决定下一步。
figures.en: Starting from a composition and target property, the agent proposes edits, evaluates them with tools, and reflects before the next step.

zh.context: LLMatDesign 根据用户指定的目标性质修改起始材料，适合材料数据不多、希望理解每次改动理由的计算探索。它不从头训练一个覆盖整个化学空间的生成模型，而让 LLM 与性质工具交替工作。
steps: 接收起始组成和目标值；若未给结构，则检索 Materials Project，按文中规则选择结构作为起点。
在添加、删除、替代和交换四类操作中选择一次组成/结构修改，用机器学习工具弛豫结构并预测新性质。
把结果与目标比较，反思上次修改并继续迭代；记录历史的版本与不使用历史的版本可用来检查经验反馈的作用。
evidence: 一个具体任务是把带隙调整到 1.4 eV，作为光伏设计的示例；另有形成能相关目标。带隙最优不是一味增大，而是接近指定值。
带隙任务中，GPT-4o 使用历史时平均约 10.8 次修改、最终带隙 1.39 eV；不使用历史为 26.6 次、1.59 eV；随机修改为 27.4 次、1.06 eV。这些是计算预测环境内的平均结果，不能当成合成后的测量值。
zh.visual: Figure 1 每轮都经历修改、弛豫、预测和反思。重点看哪些信息返回下一轮：如果只有当前性质而没有改动历史，系统可能反复尝试同类操作。结果应同时比较距目标的偏差与所需修改次数。
zh.caveat: 零样本指当前任务无需专门示例或任务训练，不表示性质预测工具没有训练数据。预测器误差、结构稳定性和可合成性仍需验证。可借鉴的是限制明确的可执行修改集合，并用结果历史指导下一次选择。

en.context: LLMatDesign modifies an initial material toward a user-specified property, using an LLM and property tools for interpretable computational search in a small-data setting.
steps: Accept a composition and target value; retrieve a starting structure from Materials Project when none is supplied.
Choose addition, removal, substitution or exchange, then relax the structure and predict properties with machine-learning tools.
Compare with the target, reflect on the modification and iterate, retaining history for subsequent decisions.
evidence: One task targets a 1.4 eV band gap as a photovoltaic-design example; others concern formation energy. Larger band gaps are not automatically better when the goal is a fixed value.

GPT-4o with history averages 10.8 modifications and 1.39 eV, versus 26.6 and 1.59 eV without history and 27.4 and 1.06 eV for random changes. These are computational predictions, not synthesized-material measurements.
en.visual: Figure 1 loops through modification, relaxation, prediction and reflection. Identify what history returns to the next decision, then assess both distance from the target and number of modifications.
en.caveat: Zero-shot adaptation does not mean the property predictors were untrained. Prediction error, stability and synthesizability still require validation. A defined action vocabulary plus outcome history is the reusable search mechanism.

papers.title: ChatMOF: An Artificial Intelligence System for Predicting and Generating Metal-Organic Frameworks Using Large Language Models
papers.name: ChatMOF

zh.problem: 用户能否通过自然语言查询、预测并生成 MOF？
zh.method: 让语言模型连接材料数据、性质预测与结构生成能力，组织交互式任务流程。
zh.evaluation: 以 MOF 检索、预测和生成任务展示；计算候选不自动等于可合成材料。

en.problem: Can users query, predict and generate MOFs through natural language?
en.method: Connects a language model to materials data, property prediction and structure-generation capabilities in an interactive workflow.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates MOF retrieval, prediction and generation; computational candidates are not automatically synthesizable materials.

papers.sourceTitle: ChatMOF: An Artificial Intelligence System for Predicting and Generating Metal-Organic Frameworks Using Large Language Models

institutions: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

zh: 统一的对话入口可以连接不同材料任务，但计算候选仍需进一步验证。
en: One conversational interface can connect several materials tasks, while computational candidates still need validation.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 用户提出问题后，代理先规划并选工具，执行结果再交给评估器。查询、性质预测和生成使用不同的工具路径。
figures.en: The agent plans and selects tools for a user's question, then an evaluator checks outputs. Retrieval, prediction and generation use different tool paths.

zh.context: ChatMOF 把自然语言变成三类 MOF 任务：查已有材料、预测性质、以及生成接近目标性质的新结构。它把语言理解与材料数据库、预测模型和结构构建工具连接起来。
steps: agent 从用户问题中提取材料约束与目标，判断需要检索、预测还是生成，再组织适当的工具调用。
生成时把 MOF 表示成拓扑与构筑单元组成的文字“基因”，选择父代并做遗传式变异、交叉，再生成对应结构文件。
用机器学习预测候选性质，按最大、最小或接近指定值的目标筛选，循环若干代后交付最符合要求的候选。
evidence: GPT-4 配置在论文所测任务中，搜索、预测和生成的任务准确率分别为 96.9%、95.7% 和 87.5%。这三项首先反映系统完成相应指令的表现，不等于所有生成材料都在实验中合成成功。
生成过程的优化反馈来自性质预测工具。因此，如果预测器在新构筑单元或新拓扑上不可靠，agent 即使正确执行了搜索，也可能选中被预测高估的结构。
zh.visual: Fig. 1 先看 agent、toolkit 和 evaluator 的职责，再区分检索已有材料与生成新材料两条路径。生成候选时应追到性质评分来源，并检查目标是极值还是指定值，避免把不同任务的成功率混读。
zh.caveat: 自然语言降低了工具使用门槛，但没有消除预测误差、化学可行性和合成验证需求。可借鉴的是先将用户目标转成明确优化规则，再把结构生成与独立性质检查分开。

en.context: ChatMOF turns natural language into MOF retrieval, property prediction and target-driven structure generation, connecting a language agent to databases and materials tools.
steps: Extract constraints and objectives, identify the task type and choose the appropriate tools.
For generation, represent a MOF as textual topology/building-block genes, select parents, mutate or cross them and construct structure files.
Predict candidate properties and select according to a maximum, minimum or target-value objective across generations.
evidence: The GPT-4 configuration achieves task accuracies of 96.9% for search, 95.7% for prediction and 87.5% for generation. These do not mean all generated materials were experimentally synthesized.
Generation is guided by learned property predictors. Correct orchestration can still select overestimated candidates when the predictor is unreliable for unfamiliar structures.
en.visual: In Fig. 1, separate agent, toolkit and evaluator responsibilities, then distinguish retrieval from generation. Trace property scores to their source and check whether the objective is an extreme or a specified value.
en.caveat: Natural-language access does not remove prediction error or synthesis constraints. Explicitly compiling the user's objective and separating generation from property checking are the reusable patterns.

papers.title: Autonomous chemical research with large language models
papers.name: Coscientist

zh.problem: 语言模型能否把化学计划转化成自动化实验？
zh.method: 结合网络与文档检索、代码执行和实验设备接口，规划并执行化学任务。
zh.evaluation: 包含六类任务及催化反应优化实验。

en.problem: Can a language model turn a chemistry plan into automated experiments?
en.method: Combines web and documentation search, code execution and laboratory interfaces to plan and run chemistry tasks.
en.evaluation: Includes six task categories and catalytic-reaction optimization experiments.

papers.sourceTitle: Autonomous chemical research with large language models

zh: 把文献理解与实验执行接起来是重点；可靠的设备接口和反馈同样关键。
en: Connecting literature understanding to experiments also requires reliable equipment interfaces and feedback.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 规划器调用网络检索、文档检索、代码和实验工具。读图时看信息怎样从文档转化为实验设备能执行的操作。
figures.en: The planner connects web search, documentation, code and laboratory tools. Trace how documentation becomes operations that experimental equipment can execute.

zh.context: Coscientist 研究从自然语言化学目标到真实自动实验的连接。它需要同时理解反应知识、设备文档与代码接口，而不是只提出一份看起来合理的实验方案。
steps: Planner 根据目标调用网络搜索与 DOCUMENTATION 模块，分别获取科学背景和具体硬件/API 的使用信息。
用 PYTHON 做计算与准备，通过 EXPERIMENT 接口操作实验设备；系统演示了 Opentrons 与 Emerald Cloud Lab 两类接口。
读取实验结果再决定后续条件，在反应优化等任务中让实际测量影响下一轮选择，而不只按最初方案固定执行。
evidence: 六类任务包括已知化合物合成规划、硬件文档检索、云实验室高层调用、移液器低层控制、多模块任务和基于历史数据的优化，分别检验不同层次的能力。
一个实验证例要求利用给定试剂与设备设计并完成 Suzuki–Miyaura 和 Sonogashira 偶联；原文用色谱和质谱与标准品对照确认产物。这比只检查命令成功返回更接近化学任务的实际验证。
zh.visual: Fig. 1 看 Planner 如何在检索、文档、代码与自动化之间切换。读后续实验图时，把设备操作记录与分析仪器证据对齐：成功控制机器、得到反应混合物和确认目标产物，需要不同证据。
zh.caveat: 可执行范围受接入设备、可用试剂和接口约束，论文展示的是特定场景的半自主或自主流程。可借鉴的是把文档检索作为实时执行依据，并让实验测量而非语言模型自信度决定任务是否完成。

en.context: Coscientist connects natural-language chemistry goals to physical automated experiments, requiring chemical knowledge, equipment documentation and executable interfaces.
steps: A planner uses web and documentation modules to obtain scientific context and hardware/API instructions.
Use Python for preparation and calculations, then invoke experiment interfaces demonstrated with Opentrons and Emerald Cloud Lab.
Read experimental outcomes and use them to choose subsequent conditions, including reaction optimization.
evidence: Six task categories cover synthesis planning, documentation navigation, cloud-lab calls, liquid-handler control, multi-module execution and data-driven optimization.

A physical demonstration designs and performs Suzuki–Miyaura and Sonogashira couplings using available resources. Chromatography and mass spectra are compared with standards, going beyond checking that device commands returned successfully.
en.visual: Fig. 1 shows the planner switching among search, documentation, code and automation. In experiment figures, distinguish operating the instrument, obtaining a mixture and confirming the intended product.
en.caveat: Capabilities depend on connected equipment, reagents and interfaces. These specific autonomous or semi-autonomous cases do not establish unrestricted laboratory operation. Documentation-grounded execution and measurement-based completion are the transferable ideas.

papers.title: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools (ChemCrow)
papers.name: ChemCrow

zh.problem: 如何弥补语言模型在化学计算和外部知识上的不足？
zh.method: 为语言模型配备 18 个专业工具，在推理、行动与观察之间循环。
zh.evaluation: 通过专家评估与化学合成、催化剂和发色团案例检验。

en.problem: How can language models compensate for gaps in chemistry computation and external knowledge?
en.method: Equips a language model with 18 specialized tools and cycles between reasoning, actions and observations.
en.evaluation: Assessed through expert evaluation and cases involving chemical synthesis, catalysts and a chromophore.

papers.sourceTitle: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools (ChemCrow)

zh: 工具提供可检查的领域能力，评估时仍要看完整任务结果。
en: Tools supply checkable domain capabilities; evaluate their contribution on complete tasks.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 语言模型借助专门化学工具完成推理和操作。不同工具处理不同问题，工具返回的结果继续影响下一步。
figures.en: A language model delegates chemistry operations to specialized tools, using returned results to guide its next reasoning step.

zh.context: ChemCrow 给 GPT-4 接入 18 个专家设计的化学工具，让模型在不擅长的计算、信息查找和实验步骤中请求外部帮助。它把 LLM 用作选择与协调工具的推理器。
steps: 向模型提供工具名称、用途和输入输出说明，模型根据当前任务判断还缺什么信息以及下一步该做什么。
模型提出具体工具与参数后暂停生成，由程序真正执行调用，再把结果作为 observation 返回；下一轮决策以观察结果为依据。
反复执行直到完成任务，可连接性质、反应、文献和机器人合成等工具，最后给出带过程依据的答案或实验产物。
evidence: 论文分析 14 个使用案例，并进行 LLM 与专家评价。实验例子包括驱虫剂和三个有机催化剂的合成，以及新发色团的发现引导；这些案例覆盖了查询到物理执行的不同层次。
工具增强的价值不只是答案更长，而是某些步骤能交由专门算法、数据库或实验平台验证。评估时仍需区分语言模型给出的判断、专家审核与真实实验测量。
zh.visual: Fig. 1a 沿推理、动作、工具输入和观察的循环读，1b 再看每种工具补足哪一类能力。观察返回之前模型必须等待实际结果，这是工具调用与直接编出化学结论的重要区别。
zh.caveat: 工具是专家预先挑选与实现的，模型仍可能选错工具、误解输入或过度解释输出。可借鉴的是把每次科学操作落实到可检查工具，并保留调用和观测链条，方便专家定位错误。

en.context: ChemCrow equips GPT-4 with 18 expert-designed chemistry tools, using the model to choose and coordinate external capabilities for calculation, information retrieval and experiments.
steps: Describe tool purposes and input/output requirements so the model can identify what information or action is needed next.
Pause generation when a tool call is requested, execute it with the supplied arguments and return the real observation.
Repeat reasoning and execution until the task is complete, using tools for properties, reactions, literature or robotic synthesis as appropriate.
evidence: The paper studies 14 use cases with LLM and expert assessment. Demonstrations include synthesis of an insect repellent and three organocatalysts, plus guidance toward a novel chromophore.

The benefit is access to specialized algorithms, databases and physical measurements, not simply more verbose answers. Model judgments, expert reviews and experimental observations remain different evidence levels.
en.visual: Follow Fig. 1a through reasoning, action, tool input and observation; use b to identify the capability each tool supplies. Waiting for an executed result distinguishes tool use from inventing a plausible chemical answer.
en.caveat: Experts define the tool collection, and the model can still select incorrectly or misinterpret outputs. An inspectable chain of calls and observations makes those failures easier to diagnose.

papers.title: ADMET-EvO: a self-evolving scientific agent for sustained research across heterogeneous tasks
papers.name: ADMET-EvO

zh.problem: 药物性质研究能否跨不同预测任务持续积累证据？
zh.method: 保存被支持、被否定与未定的结果，据此调整假设及数据、特征、模型选择。
zh.evaluation: 报告 22 项 TDC ADMET 基准及 43 项毒性相关任务；结果属于计算预测评估。

en.problem: Can drug-property research accumulate evidence across different prediction tasks?
en.method: Retains supported, rejected and inconclusive outcomes to revise hypotheses and choices about data, features and models.
en.evaluation: Reports the 22-task TDC ADMET benchmark and 43 toxicity-related tasks; results concern computational prediction.

papers.sourceTitle: ADMET-EvO: a self-evolving scientific agent for sustained research across heterogeneous tasks

zh: 22 个任务的归一化汇总分为 96.77，最接近的对比方法为 96.64；差距较小，需要结合单任务表现和计算成本理解。
en: Across 22 tasks, the normalized aggregate score is 96.77 versus 96.64 for the closest comparator; interpret this small gap alongside endpoint performance and compute cost.

figures.label: Figure 2
figures.zh: 比较各 ADMET 任务的性能与耗时。不同端点使用不同原始指标，因此归一化分数和原始数值要对照看。
figures.en: Compare performance and runtime across ADMET endpoints. Since endpoints use different metrics, read normalized scores alongside their original values.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 分数经过任务归一化，适合汇总异构 ADMET 指标；解释具体性质时仍需看原始单位与测试集。
tables.en: Task normalization summarizes heterogeneous ADMET metrics; endpoint interpretation still needs original units and test sets.

zh.context: ADMET-EvO 针对药物性质的连续计算研究。不同 endpoint 虽然都叫吸收、毒性等大类，可能来自不同物种、实验体系和测量尺度，因此不能一开始就把数据混在一起建模。
steps: 先为 endpoint 固定预测目标、指标方向、分子标识和数据划分，再检查样本量、类别不平衡、冲突测量和化学空间变化，判断有哪些可靠改进空间。
提出可证伪的假设，分别改变数据、特征或模型进行比较；用证据决定支持、拒绝还是暂不能下结论，而不只挑内部验证分最高的一次。
把三类结论连同研究记录带入下一轮，保留选中方案的理由和被拒绝替代方案，并在性能与拟合计算量之间选择。
evidence: 22 项 TDC ADMET 任务的归一化总分为 96.77，第二名 MapLight+GNN 为 96.64，相差 0.13；这是不同性质指标的汇总，并不是 96.77% 的统一准确率。另扩展了 43 个毒性相关计算任务。
计算感知选择在预先规定的非劣效范围内减少累计拟合时间 72.2%，意味着允许在明确性能容差内节省计算。Figure 2 还检查测试分子与训练集相似性和误差的关系，提示适用范围会影响预测可信度。
zh.visual: Figure 2A 先看单 endpoint 的原始单位与正负方向，Half-Life 使用断轴；B 的 MAE 方向已反转，外圈表示更好。C 看累计拟合时间，D 看相似度与误差。Table 1 的总排名应和这些细项一起读。
zh.caveat: 这些结果验证的是计算预测与研究选择流程，不能直接证明候选药物安全有效。跨 endpoint 复用还需保留测量边界。可借鉴的是让失败和不确定结果也影响下一轮，并预先固定外部评价与可接受的性能容差。

en.context: ADMET-EvO conducts continuing computational research on drug-property endpoints. Labels such as absorption or toxicity can hide different species, assays and measurement scales, so data comparability must be established first.
steps: Specify the endpoint, metric direction, molecular identity and split, then inspect scarcity, imbalance, conflicting measurements and chemical-space shift.
Test falsifiable changes to data, features or models, classifying evidence as supported, rejected or inconclusive rather than selecting only the best internal validation score.
Carry those outcomes and their provenance into later cycles, retaining reasons for selections and balancing performance against fitting cost.
evidence: Across 22 TDC tasks the normalized score is 96.77 versus 96.64 for MapLight+GNN, a 0.13-point gap rather than a universal accuracy of 96.77%. Another 43 toxicity-related computational tasks are formalized.

Compute-aware selection reduces cumulative fitting time by 72.2% within a predefined non-inferiority margin. Similarity/error analysis also examines how proximity to training chemistry relates to prediction reliability.
en.visual: In Figure 2A, inspect native metrics, direction and the Half-Life broken axis. B reverses MAE so outward is better; C measures fitting time and D examines similarity versus error. Read Table 1's aggregate with these endpoint details.
en.caveat: Computational prediction does not establish drug safety or efficacy. Reuse across endpoints must preserve measurement boundaries. Retaining failed and inconclusive findings, with fixed evaluation and performance tolerances, is the core reusable mechanism.

papers.title: An autonomous LLM-agent platform for computational binder design and conjugation-aware prioritization of antibody–drug conjugates
papers.name: OIH Platform

zh.problem: 计算结合蛋白设计如何衔接抗体药物偶联物的候选排序？
zh.method: 智能体编排结构、序列和界面评价工具，将结合蛋白设计与偶联相关筛选连接。
zh.evaluation: 论文报告五个靶点上的计算设计和筛选；没有据此确认湿实验或临床疗效。

en.problem: How can computational binder design connect to prioritizing antibody–drug conjugate candidates?
en.method: An agent orchestrates structure, sequence and interface-assessment tools, linking binder design with conjugation-aware screening.
en.evaluation: The paper reports computational design and screening across five targets, without establishing wet-lab or clinical efficacy.

papers.sourceTitle: An autonomous LLM-agent platform for computational binder design and conjugation-aware prioritization of antibody–drug conjugates

institutions: Suzhou Kai Zhi Yuan Technology Co., Ltd.

zh: 这个项目把结合蛋白设计与后续筛选串联起来；计算筛选结果不能直接当作药物有效性结论。
en: The project connects binder design to downstream screening; computational scores do not establish drug efficacy.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 自然语言入口协调工具和计算环境，按任务选择设计与筛选路径；图中还展示了工具资源和技能文件的组织方式。
figures.en: Natural-language requests coordinate tools and compute environments, choosing design and screening routes. The diagram also shows resource allocation and reusable skill files.

zh.context: OIH 将蛋白结合体设计与抗体药物偶联物候选排序组织成可执行计算流程。它重点处理多个专门生物工具之间的衔接：结构设计、序列处理、界面评价和后续候选优先级。
steps: 从自然语言任务提取靶点与设计条件，由 agent 在 Tier 1/Tier 2 路线间选择，按现有信息决定合适的设计和筛选路径。
协调 15 个容器环境中的 32 种工具，完成结构与序列相关计算，并使用 ipSAE 等界面指标筛选候选。
将执行失败整理成知识与技能，依据关键词加载相关技能文件，让后续任务参考过去的问题与解决方式。
evidence: 论文在五个肿瘤相关靶点上进行计算设计，五项靶点分类均正确，其中一项需要人工修正 hotspot 选择。示例候选的 ipTM 为 Nectin-4 0.87、HER2 0.85；这些是结构/界面相关计算指标。
框架从 265 个整理案例中提炼失败经验，并通过受控消融比较路由策略的下游评分。原文明确所有结果都还是计算预测，等待实验验证，不能把高 ipTM 或 ipSAE 当成已测得的结合效果或治疗效果。
zh.visual: Figure 1a/b 看工具如何分布在环境中，1c 看八步流程与分支，1f 看技能知识库。读结果时先确定展示的是工具执行统计、结构信心指标还是实测性质，三者不可互换。
zh.caveat: 计算排序可以帮助缩小候选，但亲和力、特异性、偶联后的行为与实际效果都需要后续实验。可借鉴的是把路由依据、工具环境和失败经验显式记录，让复杂生物计算流程可检查。

en.context: OIH orchestrates computational protein-binder design and conjugation-aware candidate prioritization. It connects specialized structure, sequence and interface-assessment tools into a runnable workflow.
steps: Extract target and design requirements, routing between Tier 1/Tier 2 paths according to the available information.
Coordinate 32 tools across 15 containerized environments and filter candidates using interface metrics including ipSAE.
Distill execution failures into knowledge and reusable skills, loading relevant skill files for later tasks.
evidence: Five oncology targets are classified correctly, with one requiring human hotspot correction. Example ipTM values are 0.87 for Nectin-4 and 0.85 for HER2; these are computational structural/interface indicators.

The platform distills 265 curated cases and compares routing strategies through ablation. The paper explicitly states that all results await experimental validation; high interface scores are not measured binding or therapeutic efficacy.
en.visual: Figure 1a/b maps tools and environments, c shows the eight-step routing workflow and f the skill library. Distinguish execution statistics, structural confidence and experimentally measured properties.
en.caveat: Affinity, specificity and behavior after conjugation need subsequent experiments. The reusable contribution is explicit routing, reproducible tool environments and retained failure knowledge for inspectable biological computation.

papers.title: Protein Design with Agent Rosetta: A Case Study for Specialized Scientific Agents
papers.name: Agent Rosetta

zh.problem: 如何让通用智能体操作复杂的物理蛋白质设计软件？
zh.method: 为 Rosetta 构建结构化交互环境，智能体根据目标反复操作并改进设计。
zh.evaluation: 比较标准与非标准氨基酸设计任务；强调环境设计对可靠操作的重要性。

en.problem: How can a general agent operate complex physics-based protein-design software?
en.method: Builds a structured interaction environment for Rosetta, allowing an agent to iteratively act on design objectives.
en.evaluation: Compares designs using canonical and non-canonical residues, emphasizing the importance of environment design for reliable operation.

papers.sourceTitle: Protein Design with Agent Rosetta: A Case Study for Specialized Scientific Agents

zh: 论文中的失败案例提醒我们：代理说想改善某性质，实际参数却可能产生相反效果。
en: An agent's stated objective can conflict with its actual parameter settings, as the paper's failure example shows.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 代理通过多轮交互操纵 Rosetta，观察输出并修改下一轮操作。重点检查自然语言目标是否被正确翻译成计算配置。
figures.en: The agent interacts with Rosetta over multiple turns, observes outputs and revises actions. Check whether the intended objective survives translation into simulation settings.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 这是分子动力学模拟结果，不是湿实验结果；中位数和置信区间描述不同结构与重复试验的差异。
tables.en: These are molecular-dynamics results, not wet-lab measurements; medians and confidence intervals summarize variation.

zh.context: Agent Rosetta 让通用语言模型操作 Rosetta 这类复杂的物理建模软件，服务于蛋白设计。重点是构造一个模型能可靠使用的环境，尤其支持许多专门 ML 设计器难处理的非天然构筑单元。
steps: 把用户设计目标与当前结构放入结构化交互环境，让 agent 能观察状态、选择 Rosetta 操作并获取执行反馈。
根据反馈逐轮修改设计，用 Rosetta 的物理建模与评分能力判断候选，而不是要求语言模型自己预测所有结构变化。
对最终设计进行独立计算评价，并比较天然氨基酸设计与插入一个非天然氨基酸的任务，检查环境是否支持更广的构筑单元。
evidence: 论文先做固定骨架的天然氨基酸稳定化设计，再研究蛋白核心中插入一个非天然残基。作者发现只改 prompt 往往无法可靠生成 Rosetta 动作，说明接口环境是能力形成的重要部分。
Table 1 是分子动力学结果：Agent Rosetta 的 RMSD 中位数 2.6 Å，人类基线为 3.1 Å，并报告区间及二级结构变化。RMSD 越小表示模拟中结构偏离较少，不等于实验测得更强结合或更好功能。
zh.visual: Figure 1 沿多轮观察、行动与反馈理解 agent。Table 1 分开读 RMSD 与 Helix/Strand/Loop 的变化，保留括号中的区间；单个中位数不能充分描述所有设计的稳定程度。
zh.caveat: 计算能量与动力学指标仍是代理证据，实验稳定性和功能需要另外验证。可借鉴的是为专门科学软件设计清晰的状态与动作接口，而不是期待增加提示词就能替代复杂环境工程。

en.context: Agent Rosetta lets general language models operate physics-based protein-design software, including non-canonical building blocks beyond the scope of many specialized ML designers.
steps: Expose the target and current structure through a structured environment where the agent can inspect state and choose Rosetta actions.
Iteratively refine candidates using Rosetta execution and physical scoring rather than relying on the model to predict every structural consequence.
Evaluate canonical-residue stabilization and insertion of a non-canonical residue, followed by additional computational checks.
evidence: The tasks include fixed-backbone stabilization and one non-canonical residue in a protein core. Prompt changes alone often fail to produce usable Rosetta actions, emphasizing the environment's role.

Table 1 reports molecular-dynamics RMSD medians of 2.6 Å for Agent Rosetta and 3.1 Å for the human baseline, with intervals and secondary-structure changes. Lower simulated deviation is not measured binding or functional improvement.
en.visual: Figure 1 is a multi-turn observation/action loop. Read RMSD and helix/strand/loop changes separately in Table 1, retaining intervals rather than relying only on medians.
en.caveat: Energy and dynamics remain computational proxies needing experimental validation. Clear state/action interfaces for specialized software are a more directly supported lesson than prompt engineering alone.

papers.title: Empowering AI data scientists using a multi-agent LLM framework with self-evolving capabilities for autonomous, tool-aware biomedical data analyses (BioMedAgent)
papers.name: BioMedAgent

zh.problem: 生物医学分析智能体怎样学习陌生工具并完成复杂任务？
zh.method: 通过多智能体协作、交互探索和记忆，学习工具用法并安排数据分析。
zh.evaluation: 在 BioMedAQA 的 327 项任务及外部 BixBench 上评估，并展示跨组学和图像任务。

en.problem: How can biomedical analysis agents learn unfamiliar tools and complete complex tasks?
en.method: Uses multi-agent collaboration, interactive exploration and memory to learn tool use and coordinate data analysis.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on 327 BioMedAQA tasks and external BixBench, with cross-omics and imaging demonstrations.

papers.sourceTitle: Empowering AI data scientists using a multi-agent LLM framework with self-evolving capabilities for autonomous, tool-aware biomedical data analyses (BioMedAgent)

institutions: Research Center for Ubiquitous Computing Systems, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
AI Cross Disciplinary Research Institute and Faculty of Medicine, Macau University of Science and Technology, Macau, China
Henan Institute of Advanced Technology, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, China
Luoyang Institute of Information Technology Industries, Luoyang, China
Beijing University of Chinese Medicine, Beijing, China
Department of Big Data and Biomedical Al, College of Future Technology, Peking University and Peking-Tsinghua Center for Life Sciences, Beijing, China
State Key Laboratory of Eye Health and National Clinical Research Center for Ocular Diseases, Eye Hospital, Wenzhou Medical University, Wenzhou, China
West China Biomedical Big Data Center, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China
Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China
Key Laboratory of RNA Biology, Center for Big Data Research in Health, Institute of Biophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China

zh: 系统的进步应落实到可重复执行的生物医学任务，而不只是更流畅的报告。
en: Improvements should appear in reproducible biomedical tasks, beyond more fluent reports.

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.zh: 先看各代理的分工，再看评估任务如何覆盖工具、编程和医学推理。完整工作流与单项问答的结果要分别理解。
figures.en: Identify agent roles and how tasks test tools, coding and biomedical reasoning. Interpret complete workflow results separately from isolated question answering.

zh.context: BioMedAgent 面向需要组合多种生物信息工具的数据分析。用户给自然语言目标，系统需要学会陌生软件的用法、处理多步依赖，并把有效经验保存下来供以后调用。
steps: 将研究目标组织为多步分析工作，安排不同 agent 协作处理工具探索、实现与结果整理，减少用户直接编程的负担。
通过实际交互探索工具，依据返回值与错误信息修正调用，再把多个工具串成可执行工作流。
把使用经验纳入记忆检索，使后续任务能参考已学工具与已有分析方式，而不是每次只依赖模型预训练知识。
evidence: 作者构建了包含 327 项生物医学数据任务的 BioMed-AQA，报告 77% 成功率，并在外部 BixBench 上检查泛化。自建 benchmark 与外部 benchmark 提供不同程度的独立性，二者应分开看。
除总分外，论文展示跨组学分析、机器学习建模和病理相关分析。它们说明工具组合可覆盖不同数据类型，但不能把一次分析输出直接等同于生物学因果发现或临床验证。
zh.visual: Fig. 1 同时展示系统和 benchmark。先追踪新工具的经验怎样进入记忆、再怎样返回后续执行；看评测部分时区分工具调用是否完成、分析输出是否符合任务，以及外部数据上的结果。
zh.caveat: 工具学习与记忆更新不意味着软件本身的统计假设自动正确。组学数据中的批次效应、样本限制和解释方式仍影响结论。可借鉴的是把工具探索作为可记录、可复用的过程，并用外部任务检查经验迁移。

en.context: BioMedAgent supports biomedical analyses requiring unfamiliar tools and multi-step dependencies. Natural-language goals initiate collaborative execution and retention of useful tool experience.
steps: Organize the goal into analysis work shared by agents handling tool exploration, implementation and result synthesis.
Learn tool behavior through interaction, correct calls using outputs and errors, and chain tools into executable workflows.
Retrieve accumulated experience for later tasks rather than relying only on pretrained knowledge.
evidence: The authors introduce BioMed-AQA with 327 biomedical data tasks and report 77% success, then evaluate generalization on external BixBench. Internal and external evaluations provide different evidence about transfer.
Demonstrations include cross-omics analysis, ML modeling and pathology-related analysis. Producing an analysis is still distinct from establishing biological causality or clinical validity.
en.visual: Fig. 1 connects the framework with its benchmark. Trace how new tool experience enters memory and influences execution, then distinguish call completion, task-correct analysis and external-task performance.
en.caveat: Learning to operate a tool does not validate its statistical assumptions. Batch effects, sample limitations and interpretation remain relevant. Recorded tool exploration plus external evaluation is the reusable approach.

papers.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical AI: Leveraging Fine-Tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 for Evidence-Based and Bias-Aware Clinical Query Processing
papers.name: Evidence-Based Medical Multi-Agent QA

zh.problem: 医学问答怎样结合证据、推理和不确定性检查？
zh.method: 结合微调模型、PubMed 检索和回答修订，并加入不确定性与偏差检查。
zh.evaluation: 使用医学问答数据评估生成质量和准确率；不构成临床部署有效性证明。

en.problem: How can medical question answering combine evidence, reasoning and uncertainty checks?
en.method: Combines fine-tuned models, PubMed retrieval and response refinement with uncertainty and bias checks.
en.evaluation: Evaluates generation quality and accuracy on medical QA data; this does not establish effectiveness in clinical deployment.

papers.sourceTitle: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical AI: Leveraging Fine-Tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 for Evidence-Based and Bias-Aware Clinical Query Processing

zh: 医学问答分数反映所测题目上的表现，不能直接推断真实诊疗效果。
en: Medical question-answering scores describe tested questions, not real-world clinical outcomes.

figures.label: Figure 6
figures.zh: 医学问题依次经过答案生成、检查与综合。观察不同组件怎样使用反馈，避免只把多个答案简单投票。
figures.en: Medical questions pass through generation, checking and synthesis. Follow how components use feedback beyond a simple vote over answers.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.zh: 同时看点估计和置信区间；这些医学问答结果不直接衡量临床获益。
tables.en: Read estimates with confidence intervals; these medical QA results do not measure clinical benefit.

zh.context: 这篇医学问答工作把模型训练与回答生成分成两层：先进行领域适配，再用不同 agent 负责证据检索、解释和修订。它试图改善答案的依据与可检查性，而不仅是语言流畅度。
steps: 使用来自 MedQuAD 的两万多条问答对 GPT、LLaMA 和 DeepSeek 系列进行适配并比较生成指标，选择模型承担不同角色。
由 PubMed 检索提供文献依据，clinical reasoning 角色产生结构化解释，refinement 角色修订内容和表达。
同时监测不确定性与有偏语言，在高不确定或特定高风险情形提供人工审查路径，再输出整理后的回答。
evidence: Table 2 的 ROUGE/BLEU 主要衡量与参考文字的重合。例如 DeepSeek 的 ROUGE-1 约 0.53、BLEU 约 0.098；这些值不是医学事实正确率，也不能与医学执照考试分数直接比较。
完整系统报告 87% accuracy 和平均 36.5 秒端到端延迟。原文还使用 perplexity 等信号评估不确定性，但文字更可预测不代表医学结论更可靠，需要结合独立正确性和校准评价。
zh.visual: Figure 6 将检索、推理、修订及监测放在同一流程中。Table 2 比较的是训练后文本生成指标；不能用它单独证明检索模块贡献，也不能把模型名称不同的结果视作只改变一个组件的消融。
zh.caveat: 这项研究是医学 QA 评测，没有验证实际诊疗收益。偏差检测和不确定性信号也只覆盖其定义的范围。可借鉴的是给回答附证据并明确何时需人工复核，同时分别测事实正确性、语言相似度和等待时间。

en.context: This medical-QA framework separates domain adaptation from a multi-agent answering pipeline, assigning evidence retrieval, reasoning and revision to different components.
steps: Adapt GPT, LLaMA and DeepSeek models using over twenty thousand MedQuAD-derived QA pairs and compare generation metrics.
Retrieve PubMed evidence, produce structured explanations and refine content through specialized agents.
Monitor uncertainty and potentially biased language, with an optional human-review path for selected cases.
evidence: Table 2's ROUGE and BLEU measure reference-text overlap. DeepSeek's roughly 0.53 ROUGE-1 and 0.098 BLEU are not medical factual accuracy or licensing-exam performance.

The full pipeline reports 87% accuracy and 36.5-second mean latency. Perplexity is also used as an uncertainty signal, but predictable wording does not by itself establish reliable medical conclusions.
en.visual: Figure 6 connects retrieval, reasoning, refinement and monitoring. Table 2 concerns adapted-model generation metrics; it does not isolate the retrieval module's effect or provide a one-factor ablation across model families.
en.caveat: This is QA evaluation rather than demonstrated clinical benefit. Bias and uncertainty checks cover their defined signals. Evidence-linked answers and explicit review paths are useful, with correctness, text similarity and latency measured separately.

papers.title: Agentic reinforcement learning empowers next-generation chemical language models for molecular design and synthesis
papers.name: ChemCRAFT

zh.problem: 较小的化学语言模型能否通过工具完成复杂推理？
zh.method: 构建化学工具轨迹与沙箱，利用化学奖励进行强化学习，让模型学习工具编排。
zh.evaluation: 评估分子结构分析、分子优化和合成路径预测。

en.problem: Can a smaller chemical language model perform complex reasoning through tools?
en.method: Builds tool trajectories and a chemistry sandbox, then uses chemistry-specific reinforcement rewards to learn tool orchestration.
en.evaluation: Evaluates molecular-structure analysis, molecular optimization and synthesis-path prediction.

papers.sourceTitle: Agentic reinforcement learning empowers next-generation chemical language models for molecular design and synthesis

zh: 训练的不只是化学知识，还包括何时调用工具以及如何使用反馈。
en: Training covers when to use tools and how to act on feedback, beyond chemistry knowledge.

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.zh: 先构造能够与化学工具交互的轨迹，再分阶段训练。训练数据需要保留工具结果与下一步决策的关系。
figures.en: Interactive chemistry trajectories feed a staged training process. The data preserve the connection between tool outputs and subsequent decisions.

tables.label: Table 1
tables.zh: 分子理解和分子编辑是不同任务，注意每列指标的定义与方向。
